bookInfo.author: Sima Guang

sentences.zh: 資治通鑑 第166卷卷第一百六十六

translations.literal: Comprehensive Mirror in Aid of Governance, Volume 166, Roll 166
translations.idiomatic: Comprehensive Mirror in Aid of Governance, Volume 166

sentences.zh: 【梁紀二十二】　起旃蒙大淵獻，盡柔兆困敦，凡二年。

translations.literal: [Liang Records 22] From Zhanmeng Dayuanxian through Rouzhao Kundun; two years in all.
translations.idiomatic: [Liang Records 22] From Zhanmeng Dayuanxian through Rouzhao Kundun—two years in all.

sentences.zh: 敬皇帝紹泰元年（

translations.literal: Emperor Jing, first year of Shaotai (
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Jing of Liang, first year of Shaotai (

sentences.zh: 乙亥，公元五五五年）

translations.literal: yihai, 555 CE)
translations.idiomatic: yihai, AD 555)

sentences.zh: 春，正月，壬午朔，邵陵太守劉棻將兵援江陵，至三百里灘，部曲宋文徹殺之，帥其眾還據邵陵。

translations.literal: In spring, the first month, on renwu the new moon, Shaoling Administrator Liu Fen led troops to relieve Jiangling; reaching Sanbaili Ford, his subordinate Song Wenche killed him and led the masses back to hold Shaoling.
translations.idiomatic: In spring, the first month, on renwu the new moon, Shaoling administrator Liu Fen marched to relieve Jiangling; at Sanbaili Ford his subordinate Song Wenche killed him and led the troops back to seize Shaoling.

sentences.zh: 梁王察即皇帝位於江陵，改元大定；

translations.literal: Liang King Cha took the imperial throne at Jiangling and changed the era name to Dading;
translations.idiomatic: Liang King Xiao Cha took the throne at Jiangling and changed the era name to Dading;

sentences.zh: 追尊昭明太子為昭明皇帝，廟號高宗，妃蔡氏為昭德皇后；

translations.literal: he posthumously honored Crown Prince Zhaoming as Emperor Zhaoming, temple name Gaozong, and his consort Lady Cai as Empress Zhaode;
translations.idiomatic: he posthumously honored Crown Prince Zhaoming as Emperor Zhaoming, temple name Gaozong, and his consort Lady Cai as Empress Zhaode;

sentences.zh: 尊其母龔氏為皇太后，立妻王氏為皇后，子巋為皇太子。

translations.literal: he honored his mother Lady Gong as Empress Dowager, made his wife Lady Wang empress, and his son Kui crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: he made his mother Lady Gong empress dowager, his wife Lady Wang empress, and his son Kui crown prince.

sentences.zh: 賞刑制度並同王者，唯上疏於魏則稱臣，奉其正朔。

translations.literal: Rewards and punishments followed the royal model; only in memorials to Wei did he style himself subject and follow Wei's calendar.
translations.idiomatic: Rewards and punishments matched those of a true sovereign; only in memorials to Western Wei did he call himself subject and follow its calendar.

sentences.zh: 至於官爵其下，亦依梁氏之舊，其勳級則兼用柱國等名。

translations.literal: As for offices and ranks below him, he also followed the old Liang pattern, while for merit grades he combined titles such as Pillar of State.
translations.idiomatic: Offices and ranks below him followed old Liang usage; merit grades combined titles such as pillar of state.

sentences.zh: 以咨議參軍蔡大寶為侍中、尚書令，參掌選事；

translations.literal: He made Advisory Aide Cai Dabao Palace Attendant and Director of the Masters of Writing, sharing control of appointments;
translations.idiomatic: He made advisory aide Cai Dabao palace attendant and director of the masters of writing, sharing control of appointments;

sentences.zh: 外兵參軍太原王操為五兵尚書。

translations.literal: and External Troops Aide Wang Cao of Taiyuan Minister of the Five Armies.
translations.idiomatic: and external troops aide Wang Cao of Taiyuan minister of the five armies.

sentences.zh: 大寶嚴整有智謀，雅達政事，文辭贍速，後梁主推心任之，以為謀主，比之諸葛孔明；

translations.literal: Dabao was stern and orderly, possessed stratagem, skilled in state affairs, and swift in literary composition; the Later Liang ruler trusted him with his whole heart as chief strategist, comparing him to Zhuge Kongming;
translations.idiomatic: Dabao was stern and shrewd, skilled in government and quick with words; the Later Liang ruler trusted him utterly as chief strategist and compared him to Zhuge Liang;

sentences.zh: 操亦亞之。

translations.literal: Cao ranked next to him.
translations.idiomatic: Cao ranked just below him.

sentences.zh: 追贈邵陵王綸太宰，謚曰壯武；

translations.literal: He posthumously enfeoffed Prince Lun of Shaoling as Grand Tutor with posthumous name Zhuangwu;
translations.idiomatic: He posthumously enfeoffed Prince Lun of Shaoling as grand tutor, posthumous name Zhuangwu;

sentences.zh: 河東王譽丞相，謚曰武桓。

translations.literal: and Prince Yu of Hedong as Chancellor with posthumous name Wuhuan.
translations.idiomatic: and Prince Yu of Hedong as chancellor, posthumous name Wuhuan.

sentences.zh: 以莫勇為武州刺史，魏永壽為巴州刺史。

translations.literal: He made Mo Yong Inspector of Wuzhou and Wei Yongshou Inspector of Bazhou.
translations.idiomatic: He made Mo Yong inspector of Wuzhou and Wei Yongshou inspector of Bazhou.

sentences.zh: 湘州刺史王琳將兵自小桂北下，至蒸城，聞江陵已陷，為世祖發哀，三軍縞素，遣別將侯平帥舟師攻後梁。

translations.literal: Xiangzhou Inspector Wang Lin led troops north from Xiaogui to Zhengcheng; hearing Jiangling had fallen, he mourned for Emperor Yuan, the whole army in white hemp, and sent detached general Hou Ping to command the fleet against Later Liang.
translations.idiomatic: Xiangzhou inspector Wang Lin marched north from Xiaogui to Zhengcheng; hearing Jiangling had fallen, he mourned Emperor Yuan, the whole army in white, and sent detached general Hou Ping with the fleet against Later Liang.

sentences.zh: 琳屯兵長沙，傳檄州郡，為進取之計。

translations.literal: Lin encamped at Changsha, issued proclamations to the provinces and commanderies, and laid plans for advance.
translations.idiomatic: Lin encamped at Changsha, issued proclamations across the provinces, and laid plans to advance.

sentences.zh: 長沙王韶及上游諸將皆推琳為盟主。

translations.literal: Prince Shao of Changsha and the upstream generals all made Lin alliance leader.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Shao of Changsha and the upstream generals all made Lin their alliance leader.

sentences.zh: 齊主使清河王岳將兵攻魏安州，以救江陵。

translations.literal: The Qi ruler sent Prince Yue of Qinghe to lead troops against Wei's Anzhou to rescue Jiangling.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Yang sent Prince Yue of Qinghe to lead troops against Anzhou in Western Wei to rescue Jiangling.

sentences.zh: 岳至義陽，江陵陷，因進軍臨江，郢州刺史陸法和及儀同三司宋蒞舉州降之；

translations.literal: Yue reached Yiyang; Jiangling fell; he therefore advanced to Linjiang; Yingzhou Inspector Lu Fahe and Acting Three Excellencies Song Li surrendered the province;
translations.idiomatic: Yue reached Yiyang; Jiangling had fallen; he advanced to Linjiang; Yingzhou inspector Lu Fahe and Song Li, equal in honor to the three dukes, surrendered the province;

sentences.zh: 長史江夏太守王鈱不從，殺之。

translations.literal: the Chief Clerk and Administrator of Jiangxia Wang Qin would not obey and was killed.
translations.idiomatic: chief clerk and Jiangxia administrator Wang Qin refused and was killed.

sentences.zh: 甲午，齊召岳還，使儀同三司清都慕容儼戍郢州。

translations.literal: On jiawu, Qi recalled Yue and sent Acting Three Excellencies Murong Yan of Qingdu to garrison Yingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, Northern Qi recalled Yue and sent Murong Yan of Qingdu, equal in honor to the three dukes, to garrison Yingzhou.

sentences.zh: 王僧辯遣江州刺史侯瑱攻郢州，任約、徐世譜、宜豐侯循皆引兵會之。

translations.literal: Wang Senbian sent Jiangzhou Inspector Hou Tian to attack Yingzhou; Ren Yue, Xu Shipu, and Marquis Xun of Yifeng all led troops to join him.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Senbian sent Jiangzhou inspector Hou Tian to attack Yingzhou; Ren Yue, Xu Shipu, and Marquis Xun of Yifeng all brought troops to join him.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，齊立貞陽侯淵明為梁主，使其上黨王渙將兵送之，徐陵、湛海珍等皆聽從淵明歸。

translations.literal: On xinchou, Qi set up Marquis Zhenyang Yuanming as Liang ruler, had Prince Huan of Shangdang escort him with troops, and permitted Xu Ling, Zhan Haizhen, and others to follow Yuanming home.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, Northern Qi set up Marquis Zhenyang Yuanming as ruler of Liang, had Prince Huan of Shangdang escort him with troops, and permitted Xu Ling, Zhan Haizhen, and others to return with Yuanming.

sentences.zh: 二月，癸丑，晉安王至自尋陽，入居朝堂，即梁王位，時年十三。

translations.literal: In the second month, on guichou, the Prince of Jin'an arrived from Xunyang, entered the court hall, and took the Liang kingship at age thirteen.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on guichou, the Prince of Jin'an arrived from Xunyang, entered the court hall, and took the Liang throne at age thirteen.

sentences.zh: 以太尉王僧辯為中書監、錄尚書、驃騎大將軍、都督中外諸軍事，加陳霸先征西大將軍，以南豫州刺史侯瑱為江州刺史，湘州刺史蕭循為太尉，廣州刺史蕭勃為司徒，鎮東將軍張彪為郢州刺史。

translations.literal: He made Grand Mentor Wang Senbian Supervisor of the Masters of Writing, Recorder of the Masters of Writing, General of Agile Cavalry, and Commander of All Forces Inside and Outside; advanced Chen Baxian to General on the Western Expedition; made South Yuzhou Inspector Hou Tian Jiangzhou Inspector, Xiangzhou Inspector Xiao Xun Grand Mentor, Guangzhou Inspector Xiao Bo Minister of Education, and Garrison-East General Zhang Biao Yingzhou Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: He made grand mentor Wang Senbian supervisor and recorder of the masters of writing, general of agile cavalry, and commander of all forces; advanced Chen Baxian to general on the western expedition; made Hou Tian Jiangzhou inspector, Xiao Xun grand mentor, Xiao Bo minister of education, and Zhang Biao Yingzhou inspector.

sentences.zh: 齊主先使殿中尚書邢子才馳傳詣建康，與王僧辯書，以為：「嗣主沖藐，未堪負荷。

translations.literal: The Qi ruler had first sent Palace Secretary Xing Zicai by rapid post to Jiankang with a letter to Wang Senbian, holding that: "The heir is young and slight, unfit to bear the burden.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Yang had first sent palace secretary Xing Zicai by rapid post to Jiankang with a letter to Wang Senbian arguing: "The heir is young and slight, unfit to bear the burden.

sentences.zh: 彼貞陽侯，梁武猶子，長沙之胤，以年以望，堪保金陵，故置為梁王，納於彼國。

translations.literal: That Marquis Zhenyang is a nephew of Liang Wudi, heir of Changsha; by years and standing he can preserve Jinling—therefore we set him up as Liang king and install him in your state.
translations.idiomatic: Marquis Zhenyang is a nephew of Emperor Wu of Liang, heir of Changsha; by years and standing he can preserve Jinling—so we set him up as king of Liang and install him in your state.

sentences.zh: 卿宜部分舟艫，迎接今主，並心一力，善建良圖。

translations.literal: You should deploy your ships, welcome the present lord, join hearts in one effort, and build a good plan."
translations.idiomatic: Deploy your fleet, welcome the present lord, join in one effort, and build a good plan."

sentences.zh: 」乙卯，貞陽侯淵明亦與僧辯書求迎。

translations.literal: " On yimao, Marquis Zhenyang Yuanming also wrote Senbian asking to be welcomed.
translations.idiomatic: " On yimao, Marquis Zhenyang Yuanming also wrote Senbian asking to be welcomed.

sentences.zh: 僧辯復書曰：「嗣主體自宸極，受於文祖。

translations.literal: Senbian replied: "The heir embodies the apex of heaven, receiving from the literary ancestor.
translations.idiomatic: Senbian replied: "The heir embodies the imperial seat, receiving from the literary ancestor.

sentences.zh: 明公倘能入朝，同獎王室，伊、呂之任，僉曰仰歸；

translations.literal: If Your Excellency could enter court and together exalt the royal house, the charge of Yi and Lü—all say they would look to you;
translations.idiomatic: If you could enter court and together exalt the royal house, the charge of Yi and Lü—all say they would look to you;

sentences.zh: 意在主盟，不敢聞命。

translations.literal: my intent is to hold the alliance—I dare not heed your command."
translations.idiomatic: my intent is to hold the alliance—I dare not heed your command."

sentences.zh: 」甲子，齊以陸法和為都督荊、雍等十州諸軍事、太尉、大都督、西南道大行台，又以宋蒞為郢州刺史，蒞弟簉為湘州刺史。

translations.literal: " On jiazi, Qi made Lu Fahe Commander-in-Chief of the Military Affairs of the ten provinces of Jing, Yong, and others, Grand Commander, Grand Commander-in-Chief, and Southwest-route Grand Commissioner; they also made Song Li inspector of Ying and Li's younger brother Qiao inspector of Xiang.
translations.idiomatic: " On jiazi, Qi made Lu Fahe commander of Jing, Yong, and nine other provinces, Grand Commander and Southwest-route Grand Commissioner; Song Li became inspector of Ying and his younger brother Qiao inspector of Xiang.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，上黨王渙克譙郡。

translations.literal: On jiaxu, Prince Huan of Shangdang took Qiao Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, Prince Huan of Shangdang took Qiao Commandery.

sentences.zh: 己卯，淵明又與僧辯書，僧辯不從。

translations.literal: On jimao, Yuanming again wrote Senbian; Senbian would not obey.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, Yuanming wrote Senbian again; Senbian refused.

sentences.zh: 魏以右僕射申徽為襄州刺史。

translations.literal: Wei made Right Vice Director Shen Hui Inspector of Xiangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Western Wei made right vice director Shen Hui inspector of Xiangzhou.

sentences.zh: 侯平攻後梁巴、武二州，故劉棻主帥趙朗殺宋文徹，以邵陵歸於王琳。

translations.literal: Hou Ping attacked Later Liang's Ba and Wu provinces; former Liu Fen's commander Zhao Lang killed Song Wenche and gave Shaoling to Wang Lin.
translations.idiomatic: Hou Ping attacked Later Liang's Ba and Wu provinces; Zhao Lang, former commander under Liu Fen, killed Song Wenche and gave Shaoling to Wang Lin.

sentences.zh: 三月，貞陽侯淵明至東關，散騎常侍裴之橫御之。

translations.literal: In the third month, Marquis Zhenyang Yuanming reached Dongguan; Regular Attendant Pei Zhiheng resisted him.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, Marquis Zhenyang Yuanming reached Dongguan; regular attendant Pei Zhiheng resisted him.

sentences.zh: 齊軍司尉瑾、儀同三司蕭軌南侵皎城，晉州刺史蕭惠以州降之。

translations.literal: Qi's Army Commander Yu Jin and Acting Three Excellencies Xiao Gui invaded south to Jiaocheng; Jinzhou Inspector Xiao Hui surrendered the province.
translations.idiomatic: Northern Qi's army commander Yu Jin and Xiao Gui, equal in honor to the three dukes, invaded Jiaocheng; Jinzhou inspector Xiao Hui surrendered the province.

sentences.zh: 齊改晉熙為江州，以尉瑾為刺史。

translations.literal: Qi changed Jinxing to Jiangzhou and made Yu Jin inspector.
translations.idiomatic: Northern Qi renamed Jinxing Jiangzhou and made Yu Jin inspector.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，齊克東關，斬裴之橫，俘數千人；

translations.literal: On bingxu, Qi took Dongguan, beheaded Pei Zhiheng, and captured several thousand;
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, Northern Qi took Dongguan, beheaded Pei Zhiheng, and captured several thousand;

sentences.zh: 王僧辯大懼，出屯姑孰，謀納淵明。

translations.literal: Wang Senbian was greatly afraid, went out to encamp at Gudu, and planned to install Yuanming.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Senbian was terrified, encamped at Gudu, and planned to install Yuanming.

sentences.zh: 丙申，齊主還鄴，封世宗二子孝珩為廣寧王，延宗為安德王。

translations.literal: On bingshen, the Qi ruler returned to Ye, enfeoffed heir's sons Xiaohang as Prince of Guangning and Yanzong as Prince of Ande.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, Gao Yang returned to Ye and enfeoffed his heir's sons Xiaohang as Prince of Guangning and Yanzong as Prince of Ande.

sentences.zh: 孫□易聞江陵陷，棄廣州還，曲江侯勃復據有之。

translations.literal: Sun □ Yi, hearing Jiangling had fallen, abandoned Guangzhou and returned; Marquis Bo of Qujiang again seized it.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Yi, hearing Jiangling had fallen, abandoned Guangzhou and returned; Marquis Bo of Qujiang seized it again.

sentences.zh: 魏太師泰遣王克、沈炯等還江南。

translations.literal: Wei Grand Preceptor Tai sent Wang Ke, Shen Jiong, and others back to the south.
translations.idiomatic: Yuwen Tai sent Wang Ke, Shen Jiong, and others back south.

sentences.zh: 泰得庾季才，厚遇之，令參掌太史。

translations.literal: Tai obtained Yu Jicai, treated him generously, and had him share charge of the Grand Astrologer.
translations.idiomatic: Tai obtained Yu Jicai, treated him generously, and had him share charge of the grand astrologer.

sentences.zh: 季才散私財，購親舊之為奴婢者。

translations.literal: Jicai distributed private wealth to redeem kinsmen and friends who had become slaves.
translations.idiomatic: Jicai spent private wealth to redeem kinsmen and friends sold into slavery.

sentences.zh: 泰問：「何能如是？

translations.literal: Tai asked: "How can you do thus?
translations.idiomatic: Tai asked: "How can you do this?

sentences.zh: 」對曰：「僕聞克國禮賢，言之道也。

translations.literal: " He replied, "I have heard that conquering a state means honoring the worthy—that is the Way of speech."
translations.idiomatic: " He replied, "I have heard that to conquer a state one honors the worthy—that is the way of words."

sentences.zh: 今郢都覆沒，其君信有罪矣，搢紳何咎，皆為皁隸！

translations.literal: He answered: "Your servant has heard that conquering a state means honoring the worthy—that is the Way.
translations.idiomatic: He answered: "I have heard that conquering a state means honoring the worthy—that is the Way.

sentences.zh: 鄙人羈旅，不敢獻言，誠切哀之，故私購之耳。

translations.literal: Now Ying's capital is overthrown; its lord truly has guilt, but what fault have the gentry—they all became black-clad slaves!
translations.idiomatic: Ying's capital is overthrown; its lord is guilty, but what fault have the gentry—they were all made slaves!

sentences.zh: 」泰乃悟，曰：「吾之過也！

translations.literal: This humble traveler dared not speak up, yet truly pitied them, and so privately redeemed them."
translations.idiomatic: I was only a traveler and dared not speak, yet I pitied them and redeemed them privately."

sentences.zh: 微君，遂失天下之望！

translations.literal: Without you I would have lost the world's regard!"
translations.idiomatic: Without you I would have lost the world's regard!"

sentences.zh: 」因出令，免梁俘為奴婢者數千口。

translations.literal: " He then issued an order freeing several thousand Liang captives who had been made slaves and servants.
translations.idiomatic: " He then issued an order freeing several thousand Liang captives who had been enslaved.

sentences.zh: 夏，四月，庚申，齊主如晉陽。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on gengshen, the Qi ruler went to Jinyang.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, the fourth month, on gengshen, Gao Yang went to Jinyang.

sentences.zh: 五月，庚辰，侯平等擒莫勇、魏永壽。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on gengchen, Hou Ping and others captured Mo Yong and Wei Yongshou.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on gengchen, Hou Ping and others captured Mo Yong and Wei Yongshou.

sentences.zh: 江陵之陷也，永嘉王莊生七年矣，尼法慕匿之，王琳迎莊，送之建康。

translations.literal: When Jiangling fell, Prince Zhuang of Yongjia was seven; the nun Famu hid him; Wang Lin received Zhuang and sent him to Jiankang.
translations.idiomatic: When Jiangling fell, Prince Zhuang of Yongjia was seven; the nun Famu hid him; Wang Lin received Zhuang and sent him to Jiankang.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，齊主還鄴。

translations.literal: On gengyin, the Qi ruler returned to Ye.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, Gao Yang returned to Ye.

sentences.zh: 王僧辯遣使奉啟於貞陽侯淵明，定君臣之禮，又遣別使奉表於齊，以子顯及顯母劉氏、弟子世珍為質於淵明，遣左民尚書周弘正至歷陽奉迎，因求以晉安王為皇太子；

translations.literal: Wang Senbian sent envoys with submission to Marquis Zhenyang Yuanming to fix lord-and-subject rites, also sent separate envoys with a memorial to Qi, gave his son Xian and Xian's mother Lady Liu and nephew Shizhen as hostages to Yuanming, sent Left Minister of the People Zhou Hongzheng to Liyang to welcome him, and asked that the Prince of Jin'an be made crown prince;
translations.idiomatic: Wang Senbian sent envoys to Marquis Zhenyang Yuanming to fix lord-and-subject rites, sent a separate memorial to Northern Qi, gave his son Xian, Xian's mother Lady Liu, and nephew Shizhen as hostages to Yuanming, sent Zhou Hongzheng to Liyang to welcome him, and asked that the Prince of Jin'an be made crown prince;

sentences.zh: 淵明許之。

translations.literal: Yuanming consented.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanming agreed.

sentences.zh: 淵明求度衛士三千，僧辯慮其為變，止受散卒千人。

translations.literal: Yuanming asked to bring three thousand palace guards across; Senbian feared trouble and accepted only a thousand scattered troops.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanming asked to bring three thousand palace guards across; Senbian feared a coup and accepted only a thousand scattered troops.

sentences.zh: 庚子，遣龍舟法駕迎之。

translations.literal: On gengzi, he sent the dragon boats and imperial equipage to welcome him.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, he sent the dragon boats and imperial equipage to welcome him.

sentences.zh: 淵明與齊上黨王渙盟於江北，辛丑，自採石濟江。

translations.literal: Yuanming made covenant with Qi's Prince Huan of Shangdang north of the river; on xinchou he crossed from Caishi.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanming made covenant with Prince Huan of Shangdang north of the river; on xinchou he crossed from Caishi.

sentences.zh: 於是梁輿南渡，齊師北返。

translations.literal: Thereupon Liang's carriages went south across the river and Qi's army returned north.
translations.idiomatic: Liang's court went south across the river and Northern Qi's army returned north.

sentences.zh: 僧辯疑齊，擁楫中流，不敢就西岸。

translations.literal: Senbian distrusted Qi, hugged the oars midstream, and dared not approach the west bank.
translations.idiomatic: Senbian distrusted Northern Qi, held midstream with oars shipped, and dared not approach the west bank.

sentences.zh: 齊侍中裴英起衛送淵明，與僧辯會於江寧。

translations.literal: Qi's Palace Attendant Pei Yingqi escorted Yuanming and met Senbian at Jiangning.
translations.idiomatic: Northern Qi's palace attendant Pei Yingqi escorted Yuanming and met Senbian at Jiangning.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，淵明入建康，望朱雀門而哭，道逆者以哭對。

translations.literal: On guimao, Yuanming entered Jiankang, looked toward the Vermilion Bird Gate and wept; those who met him on the road answered with weeping.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, Yuanming entered Jiankang, gazed toward the Vermilion Bird Gate and wept; passersby wept back.

sentences.zh: 丙午，即皇帝位，改元天成，以晉安王為皇太子，王僧辯為大司馬，陳霸先為侍中。

translations.literal: On bingwu, he took the imperial throne, changed the era to Tiancheng, made the Prince of Jin'an crown prince, Wang Senbian Grand Marshal, and Chen Baxian Palace Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, he took the throne, changed the era to Tiancheng, made the Prince of Jin'an crown prince, Wang Senbian grand marshal, and Chen Baxian palace attendant.

sentences.zh: 六月，庚戌朔，齊發民一百八十萬築長城，自幽州夏口西至恆州九百餘里，命定州刺史趙郡王睿將兵監之。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on gengxu the new moon, Qi mobilized 1.8 million people to build the Long Wall from Xiakou west of Youzhou to Hengzhou, more than nine hundred li, and ordered Dingzhou Inspector Prince Rui of Zhao to lead troops to supervise.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on gengxu the new moon, Northern Qi mobilized 1.8 million people to build the Long Wall from Xiakou west of Youzhou to Hengzhou, more than nine hundred li, and ordered Dingzhou inspector Prince Rui of Zhao to supervise.

sentences.zh: 睿，琛之子也。

translations.literal: Rui was a son of Chen.
translations.idiomatic: Rui was Chen's son.

sentences.zh: 齊慕容儼始入郢州，而侯瑱等奄至城下，儼隨方備御，瑱等不能克；

translations.literal: When Murong Yan of Qi first entered Yingzhou, Hou Tian and others suddenly reached the walls; Yan defended as each side required and Tian could not overcome him;
translations.idiomatic: When Murong Yan of Northern Qi first entered Yingzhou, Hou Tian and others suddenly appeared below the walls; Yan defended on every side and Tian could not take it;

sentences.zh: 乘間出擊瑱等軍，大破之。

translations.literal: seizing an opening he sallied against Tian's army and routed it.
translations.idiomatic: seizing an opening he sallied and routed Tian's army.

sentences.zh: 城中食盡，煮草木根葉及靴皮帶角食之，與士卒分甘共苦，堅守半歲，人無異志。

translations.literal: Food in the city was exhausted; they boiled roots and leaves of plants and trees and ate boot leather, belts, and horn, sharing sweetness and bitterness with the soldiers; they held half a year without change of heart.
translations.idiomatic: Food ran out; they boiled roots and leaves and ate boot leather, belts, and horn, sharing hardship with the soldiers; they held half a year without wavering.

sentences.zh: 貞陽侯淵明立，乃命瑱等解圍，瑱還鎮豫章。

translations.literal: When Marquis Zhenyang Yuanming was established, he ordered Tian and others to lift the siege; Tian returned to garrison Yuzhang.
translations.idiomatic: When Marquis Zhenyang Yuanming was established, he ordered Tian to lift the siege; Tian returned to Yuzhang.

sentences.zh: 齊人以城在江外難守，因割以還梁。

translations.literal: Qi men, finding the city hard to hold beyond the river, ceded it back to Liang.
translations.idiomatic: Northern Qi, finding the city hard to hold beyond the river, ceded it back to Liang.

sentences.zh: 儼歸，望齊主，悲不自勝。

translations.literal: Yan returned, saw the Qi ruler, and grief overcame him.
translations.idiomatic: Yan returned, saw Gao Yang, and grief overcame him.

sentences.zh: 齊主呼前，執其手，脫帽看發，歎息久之。

translations.literal: The Qi ruler called him forward, took his hand, removed his cap to look at his hair, and sighed long.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Yang called him forward, took his hand, removed his cap to look at his hair, and sighed long.

sentences.zh: 吳興太守杜龕，王僧辯之婿也。

translations.literal: Administrator of Wuxing Du Kan was Wang Senbian's son-in-law.
translations.idiomatic: Administrator of Wuxing Du Kan was Wang Senbian's son-in-law.

sentences.zh: 僧辯以吳興為震州，用龕為刺史，又以其弟侍中僧愔為豫章太守。

translations.literal: Senbian made Wuxing Zhenzhou and used Kan as inspector, and also made his younger brother Palace Attendant Sengyin Administrator of Yuzhang.
translations.idiomatic: Senbian made Wuxing into Zhenzhou with Kan as inspector, and made his younger brother palace attendant Sengyin administrator of Yuzhang.

sentences.zh: 壬子，齊主以梁國稱籓，詔凡梁民悉遣南還。

translations.literal: On renzi, the Qi ruler, because Liang styled itself vassal, ordered all Liang people sent back south.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, because Liang styled itself vassal, Gao Yang ordered all Liang subjects sent back south.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，齊主如晉陽；

translations.literal: On dingmao, the Qi ruler went to Jinyang;
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, Gao Yang went to Jinyang;

sentences.zh: 壬申，自將擊柔然。

translations.literal: on renshen he personally led the attack on Rouran.
translations.idiomatic: on renshen he personally led the attack on Rouran.

sentences.zh: 秋，七月，己卯，至白道，留輜重，帥輕騎五千追柔然，壬午，及之於懷朔鎮。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on jimao, he reached Baidao, left the baggage train, and led five thousand light horse in pursuit of Rouran; on renwu he caught them at Huaishuo Garrison.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, the seventh month, on jimao, he reached Baidao, left the baggage train, and led five thousand light horse after Rouran; on renwu he caught them at Huaishuo.

sentences.zh: 齊主親犯矢石，頻戰，大破之。

translations.literal: The Qi ruler personally braved arrows and stones, fought repeatedly, and routed them.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Yang personally braved arrows and stones, fought repeatedly, and routed them.

sentences.zh: 至於沃野，獲其酋長，及生口二萬餘，牛羊數十萬。

translations.literal: Reaching Woye, he captured their chieftains and more than twenty thousand living captives and hundreds of thousands of cattle and sheep.
translations.idiomatic: Reaching Woye, he captured their chieftains, more than twenty thousand captives, and hundreds of thousands of cattle and sheep.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，還晉陽。

translations.literal: On renchen, he returned to Jinyang.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, he returned to Jinyang.

sentences.zh: 八月，辛巳，王琳自蒸城還長沙。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on xinsi, Wang Lin returned from Zhengcheng to Changsha.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on xinsi, Wang Lin returned from Zhengcheng to Changsha.

sentences.zh: 齊主還鄴，以佛、道二教不同，欲去其一，集二家學者論難於前，遂敕道士皆剃髮為沙門；

translations.literal: The Qi ruler returned to Ye; because Buddhist and Daoist teachings differed, he wished to abolish one; he gathered scholars of both schools to debate before him and ordered Daoist priests all to shave their heads and become monks;
translations.idiomatic: Gao Yang returned to Ye; because Buddhist and Daoist teachings differed, he wished to abolish one; he gathered scholars of both schools to debate before him and ordered Daoist priests to shave their heads and become monks;

sentences.zh: 有不從者，殺四人，乃奉命。

translations.literal: those who would not obey—four were killed—and then all obeyed.
translations.idiomatic: four who refused were killed—and then all obeyed.

sentences.zh: 於是齊境皆無道士。

translations.literal: Thereupon within Qi's borders there were no Daoist priests.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon within Northern Qi there were no Daoist priests.

sentences.zh: 初，王僧辯與陳霸先共滅侯景，情好甚篤，僧辯為子頠娶霸先女，會僧辯有母喪，未成昏。

translations.literal: At first Wang Senbian and Chen Baxian together destroyed Hou Jing and were on very close terms; Senbian had his son Pin marry Baxian's daughter, but Senbian had a mother's mourning and the wedding was not completed.
translations.idiomatic: At first Wang Senbian and Chen Baxian together destroyed Hou Jing and were very close; Senbian betrothed his son Pin to Baxian's daughter, but Senbian was in mourning for his mother and the wedding was not completed.

sentences.zh: 僧辯居石頭城，霸先在京口，僧辯推心待之，頠兄顗屢諫，不聽。

translations.literal: Senbian dwelt at Stone City and Baxian at Jingkou; Senbian treated him with open heart, but Pin's elder brother Yan remonstrated repeatedly and was not heeded.
translations.idiomatic: Senbian dwelt at Stone City and Baxian at Jingkou; Senbian treated him with open heart, but Pin's elder brother Yan remonstrated repeatedly in vain.

sentences.zh: 及僧辯納貞陽侯淵明，霸先遣使苦爭之，往返數四，僧辯不從。

translations.literal: When Senbian installed Marquis Zhenyang Yuanming, Baxian sent envoys to argue bitterly back and forth four times; Senbian would not obey.
translations.idiomatic: When Senbian installed Marquis Zhenyang Yuanming, Baxian sent envoys to argue bitterly four times; Senbian would not listen.

sentences.zh: 霸先切歎，謂所親曰：「武帝子孫甚多，唯孝元能復仇雪恥，其子何罪，而忽廢之！

translations.literal: Baxian sighed deeply and told those close to him: "Emperor Wu's descendants are many; only Emperor Yuan could avenge and wipe shame—what crime has his son, that he is suddenly set aside!
translations.idiomatic: Baxian sighed and told his intimates: "Emperor Wu's descendants are many; only Emperor Yuan could avenge and wipe away shame—what crime has his son, that he is suddenly set aside!

sentences.zh: 吾與王公並處托孤之地，而王公一旦改圖，外依戎狄，援立非次，其志欲何所為乎！

translations.literal: I and Lord Wang both stand where orphans were entrusted, yet Lord Wang suddenly changes course, leans on barbarians from without, and raises one out of order—what does he intend!"
translations.idiomatic: Lord Wang and I both stand where orphans were entrusted, yet he suddenly changes course, leans on barbarians from without, and raises one out of order—what does he intend!"

sentences.zh: 」乃密具袍數千領及錦彩金銀為賞賜之具。

translations.literal: " He secretly prepared several thousand robes and brocades, gold, and silver as gifts.
translations.idiomatic: " He secretly prepared several thousand robes, brocades, gold, and silver for rewards.

sentences.zh: 會有告齊師大舉至壽春將入寇者，僧辯遣記室江旰告霸先，使為之備。

translations.literal: It happened that someone reported Qi's army was coming in force to Shouchun about to invade; Senbian sent Recorder Jiang Gan to tell Baxian to prepare.
translations.idiomatic: Someone reported Northern Qi's army was marching in force on Shouchun to invade; Senbian sent recorder Jiang Gan to warn Baxian to prepare.

sentences.zh: 霸先因是留旰於京口，舉兵襲僧辯。

translations.literal: Baxian therefore kept Gan at Jingkou and raised troops to strike Senbian.
translations.idiomatic: Baxian kept Gan at Jingkou and raised troops to strike Senbian.

sentences.zh: 九月，壬寅，召部將侯安都、周文育及安陸徐度、錢塘杜稜謀之。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on renyin, he summoned generals Hou Andu, Zhou Wenyu, Xu Du of Anlu, and Du Ling of Qiantang to plot it.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on renyin, he summoned generals Hou Andu, Zhou Wenyu, Xu Du of Anlu, and Du Ling of Qiantang to plot it.

sentences.zh: 稜以為難，霸先懼其謀洩，以手巾絞稜，悶絕於地，因閉於別室。

translations.literal: Ling thought it hard; Baxian feared his plot would leak, strangled Ling with a hand towel until he fainted on the ground, and shut him in a separate room.
translations.idiomatic: Ling balked; Baxian feared a leak, strangled him with a hand towel until he fainted, and shut him in a side room.

sentences.zh: 部分將士，分賜金帛，以弟子著作郎曇朗鎮京口，知留府事，使徐度、侯安都帥水軍趨石頭，霸先帥馬步自江乘羅落會之。

translations.literal: He deployed officers and soldiers, distributed gold and silk, had his nephew Attendant Gentleman of the Secretariat Tanlang garrison Jingkou and manage remaining capital affairs, sent Xu Du and Hou Andu to lead the fleet toward Stone City, and Baxian led horse and foot from Jiangcheng Luoluo to join them.
translations.idiomatic: He deployed the troops and distributed gold and silk, left his nephew Tanlang to garrison Jingkou and manage the capital, sent Xu Du and Hou Andu with the fleet toward Stone City, and led horse and foot from Jiangcheng Luoluo to join them.

sentences.zh: 是夜，皆發，召杜稜與同行。

translations.literal: That night all set out and he summoned Du Ling to go with them.
translations.idiomatic: That night all set out; he summoned Du Ling to come along.

sentences.zh: 知其謀者，唯安都等四將，外人皆以為江旰徵兵御齊，不之怪也。

translations.literal: Those who knew the plot were only Andu and the other four generals; outsiders all thought Jiang Gan was mobilizing troops against Qi and were not suspicious.
translations.idiomatic: Only Andu and the other four knew the plot; everyone else thought Jiang Gan was mobilizing against Northern Qi and suspected nothing.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，安都引舟艦將趣石頭，霸先控馬未進，安都大懼，追霸先罵曰：「今日作賊，事勢已成，生死須決，在後欲何所望！

translations.literal: On jiachen, Andu led the ships toward Stone City; Baxian held his horse and did not advance; Andu was greatly afraid, pursued Baxian and cursed: "Today we are rebels—the matter is already done; life and death must be decided—hanging back, what do you hope for!
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, Andu led the ships toward Stone City; Baxian held his horse and would not advance; Andu was terrified, rode up and cursed: "Today we are rebels—the deed is done; life and death must be settled—hanging back, what do you hope for!

sentences.zh: 若敗，俱死，後期得免斫頭邪？

translations.literal: If we fail, we die together—do you think you can escape beheading later!"
translations.idiomatic: If we fail, we die together—do you think you can escape the headsman's blade later!"

sentences.zh: 」霸先曰：「安都嗔我！

translations.literal: " Baxian said, "Andu is angry with me!
translations.idiomatic: " Baxian said, "Andu is furious with me!

sentences.zh: 」乃進。
安都至石頭城北，棄舟登岸。

translations.literal: Andu reached the north of Stone City, abandoned the boats and went ashore.
translations.idiomatic: Andu reached the north of Stone City, abandoned the boats, and went ashore.

sentences.zh: 石頭城北接岡阜，不甚危峻。

translations.literal: The north of Stone City joined hillocks and was not very steep.
translations.idiomatic: The north of Stone City backed onto hills and was not very steep.

sentences.zh: 安都被甲帶長刀，軍人捧之，投於女垣內，眾隨而入，進及僧辯臥室。

translations.literal: Andu donned armor and carried a long blade; soldiers lifted him and threw him over the parapet; the masses followed inside and advanced to Senbian's bedchamber.
translations.idiomatic: Andu donned armor and a long blade; soldiers lifted him and threw him over the parapet; the rest poured in and reached Senbian's bedchamber.

sentences.zh: 霸先兵亦自南門入。

translations.literal: Baxian's troops also entered from the south gate.
translations.idiomatic: Baxian's troops also entered from the south gate.

sentences.zh: 僧辯方視事，外白有兵，俄而兵自內出。

translations.literal: Senbian was just handling affairs when the outside reported troops; presently troops came out from within.
translations.idiomatic: Senbian was at his desk when word came of troops; presently troops burst out from within.

sentences.zh: 僧辯遽走，遇子頠，與俱出閣，帥左右數十人苦戰於廳事前，力不敵，走登南門樓，拜請求哀。

translations.literal: Senbian fled in haste, met his son Pin, and together left the pavilion; he led several dozen men on his left and right in bitter fighting before the hall, strength failed, and he fled up the south gate tower, bowing and begging mercy.
translations.idiomatic: Senbian fled, met his son Pin, and they left the pavilion together; he led a few dozen men in a desperate fight before the hall, was overpowered, and fled up the south gate tower, bowing and begging mercy.

sentences.zh: 霸先欲縱火焚之，僧辯與頠俱下就執。

translations.literal: Baxian wished to set fire and burn them; Senbian and Pin both came down and were seized.
translations.idiomatic: Baxian meant to burn them out; Senbian and Pin came down and were seized.

sentences.zh: 霸先曰：「我有何辜，公欲與齊師賜討？

translations.literal: Baxian said: "What crime have I, that you would join Qi troops to grant me punishment?
translations.idiomatic: Baxian said: "What crime have I, that you would join Northern Qi to strike me down?

sentences.zh: 」且曰：「何意全無備？

translations.literal: " and added, "Why are you completely unprepared?"
translations.idiomatic: " and added, "Why are you utterly without preparations?"

sentences.zh: 」僧辯曰：「委公北門，何謂無備？

translations.literal: " Senbian said, "I entrusted the north gate to you—how can you say there were no preparations?"
translations.idiomatic: " Senbian said, "I left the north gate to you—how can you say there were none?"

sentences.zh: 」是夜，霸先縊殺僧辯父子。

translations.literal: " That night Baxian strangled Senbian and his son.
translations.idiomatic: " That night Baxian strangled Senbian and his son.

sentences.zh: 既而竟無齊兵，亦非霸先之譎也。

translations.literal: Afterward there were no Qi troops at all—it was not Baxian's trick either.
translations.idiomatic: Afterward there were no Qi troops at all—it was not Baxian's ruse either.

sentences.zh: 前青州刺史新安程靈洗帥所領救僧辯，力戰於石頭西門，軍敗。

translations.literal: Former Qingzhou Inspector Cheng Lingxi of Xin'an led his command to rescue Senbian and fought hard at Stone City's west gate; his army was defeated.
translations.idiomatic: Former Qingzhou inspector Cheng Lingxi of Xin'an led his command to rescue Senbian and fought hard at Stone City's west gate; his army was beaten.

sentences.zh: 霸先遣使招諭，久之乃降。

translations.literal: Baxian sent envoys to summon and instruct him; after long time he surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: Baxian sent envoys to win him over; after a long while he surrendered.

sentences.zh: 霸先義之，以為蘭陵太守，使助防京口。

translations.literal: Baxian honored his loyalty, made him Administrator of Lanling, and had him help defend Jingkou.
translations.idiomatic: Baxian honored his loyalty, made him administrator of Lanling, and had him help defend Jingkou.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，霸先為檄佈告中外，列僧辯罪狀，且曰：「資斧所指，唯王僧辯父子兄弟，其餘親黨，一無所問。

translations.literal: On yisi, Baxian issued a proclamation to all within and without, listing Senbian's crimes, and said: "Where the punitive axe points is only Wang Senbian, father, sons, and brothers; all other kin and partisans—no questions asked.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, Baxian issued a proclamation within and without, listing Senbian's crimes, and said: "The axe falls only on Wang Senbian, father, sons, and brothers; all other kin and partisans go unasked.

sentences.zh: 丙午，貞陽侯淵明遜位，出就邸，百僚上晉安王表，勸進。

translations.literal: On bingwu, Marquis Zhenyang Yuanming yielded the throne and went out to his residence; the hundred officials submitted a memorial to the Prince of Jin'an urging him to advance.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, Marquis Zhenyang Yuanming abdicated and went to his residence; the hundred officials memorialized the Prince of Jin'an to advance.

sentences.zh: 冬，十月，己酉，晉安王即皇帝位，大赦，改元，中外文武賜位一等。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on jiyou, the Prince of Jin'an took the imperial throne, proclaimed a general amnesty, changed the era name, and advanced all civil and military one rank.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, the tenth month, on jiyou, the Prince of Jin'an took the throne, proclaimed a general amnesty, changed the era name, and advanced all civil and military one rank.

sentences.zh: 以貞陽侯淵明為司徒，封建安公。

translations.literal: He made Marquis Zhenyang Yuanming Minister of Education and enfeoffed him Duke of Jian'an.
translations.idiomatic: He made Marquis Zhenyang Yuanming minister of education and enfeoffed him Duke of Jian'an.

sentences.zh: 告齊云：「僧辯陰圖篡逆，故誅之。

translations.literal: He told Qi: "Senbian secretly plotted usurpation, therefore he was executed.
translations.idiomatic: He told Northern Qi: "Senbian secretly plotted usurpation, therefore he was executed.

sentences.zh: 」仍請稱臣於齊，永為籓國。

translations.literal: " He still asked to submit as a minister to Qi and forever be a tributary state.
translations.idiomatic: " He still asked to submit as Qi's minister and remain a tributary state forever.

sentences.zh: 齊遣行台司馬恭與梁人盟於歷陽。

translations.literal: Qi sent Mobile Headquarters Commander Sima Gong to covenant with Liang men at Liyang.
translations.idiomatic: Northern Qi sent mobile headquarters commander Sima Gong to covenant with Liang at Liyang.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，齊主如晉陽。

translations.literal: On xinhai, the Qi ruler went to Jinyang.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, Gao Yang went to Jinyang.

sentences.zh: 壬子，加陳霸先尚書令、都督中外諸軍事、車騎將軍、揚、南徐二州刺史。

translations.literal: On renzi, Chen Baxian was advanced to Director of the Masters of Writing, Commander of All Forces Inside and Outside, General of the War Chariots, and Inspector of Yang and South Xuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, Chen Baxian was made director of the masters of writing, commander of all forces inside and outside, general of the war chariots, and inspector of Yang and South Xuzhou.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，以宜豐侯循為太保，建安公淵明為太傅，曲江侯勃為太尉，王琳為車騎將軍、開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: On guichou, Marquis Xun of Yifeng was made Grand Tutor, Duke Yuanming of Jian'an Grand Mentor, Marquis Bo of Qujiang Grand Mentor, and Wang Lin General of the War Chariots, equal in honor to the three dukes with an open office.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, Marquis Xun of Yifeng was made grand tutor, Duke Yuanming of Jian'an grand mentor, Marquis Bo of Qujiang grand mentor, and Wang Lin general of the war chariots with an open office equal to the three dukes.

sentences.zh: 戊午，尊帝所生夏貴妃為皇太后，立妃王氏為皇后。

translations.literal: On wuwu, the emperor honored his birth mother Noble Consort Xia as Empress Dowager and made Consort Wang empress.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, the emperor honored his birth mother Noble Consort Xia as empress dowager and made Consort Wang empress.

sentences.zh: 杜龕恃王僧辯之勢，素不禮於陳霸先。

translations.literal: Du Kan relied on Wang Senbian's power and was never courteous to Chen Baxian.
translations.idiomatic: Du Kan relied on Wang Senbian's power and never showed courtesy to Chen Baxian.

sentences.zh: 在吳興，每以法繩其宗族，霸先深怨之。

translations.literal: At Wuxing he often bound his clan by law; Baxian deeply resented him.
translations.idiomatic: At Wuxing he often bound his clan by law; Baxian deeply resented him.

sentences.zh: 及將圖僧辯，密使兄子茜還長城，立柵以備龕。

translations.literal: When about to plot against Senbian, he secretly sent his elder brother's son Qian back to Changcheng to build ramparts against Kan.
translations.idiomatic: When he plotted against Senbian, he secretly sent his nephew Qian back to Changcheng to build ramparts against Kan.

sentences.zh: 僧辯死，龕據吳興拒霸先，義興太守韋載以郡應之。

translations.literal: When Senbian died, Kan held Wuxing and resisted Baxian; Yixing Administrator Wei Zai responded with the commandery.
translations.idiomatic: When Senbian died, Kan held Wuxing and resisted Baxian; Yixing administrator Wei Zai joined him with the commandery.

sentences.zh: 吳郡太守王僧智，僧辯之弟也，亦據城守。

translations.literal: Administrator of Wu Commandery Wang Sengzhi, Senbian's younger brother, also held the city.
translations.idiomatic: Wu commandery administrator Wang Sengzhi, Senbian's younger brother, also held the city.

sentences.zh: 陳茜至長城，收兵才數百人，杜龕遣其將杜泰將精兵五千奄至，將士相視失色。

translations.literal: Chen Qian reached Changcheng and gathered barely several hundred soldiers; Du Kan sent his general Du Tai with five thousand crack troops in a sudden arrival; officers and soldiers looked at one another and paled.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Qian reached Changcheng with barely several hundred men; Du Kan sent Du Tai with five thousand crack troops in a sudden strike; the officers paled.

sentences.zh: 茜言笑自若，部分益明，眾心乃定。

translations.literal: Qian was smiling and at ease as he deployed, clearer than before; the masses' hearts were then settled.
translations.idiomatic: Qian smiled and deployed with clear calm; the men's hearts steadied.

sentences.zh: 泰日夜苦攻數旬，不克而退。

translations.literal: Tai attacked bitterly day and night for several tens of days, could not overcome them, and withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Tai attacked day and night for weeks, failed, and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 霸先使周文育攻義興，義興屬縣卒皆霸先舊兵，善用弩，韋載收得數十人，系以長鎖，命所親監之，使射文育軍，約曰：「十發不兩中者死。

translations.literal: Baxian sent Zhou Wenyu to attack Yixing; Yixing's subordinate county soldiers were all Baxian's old troops, skilled with crossbows; Wei Zai collected several dozen men, chained them with long locks, had those close to him supervise them, and had them shoot at Wenyu's army, stipulating: "Ten shots without two hits—death.
translations.idiomatic: Baxian sent Zhou Wenyu against Yixing; Yixing's county soldiers were Baxian's old troops, skilled with crossbows; Wei Zai chained several dozen men, had his intimates supervise them, and made them shoot at Wenyu's army on the rule: ten shots without two hits meant death.

sentences.zh: 」故每發輒斃一人，文育軍稍卻。

translations.literal: " Therefore each time he shot an arrow he killed a man; Wenyü's army drew back somewhat.
translations.idiomatic: " Each time he loosed an arrow he killed someone, and Wenyü's army fell back a little.

sentences.zh: 載因於城外據水立柵，相持數旬。

translations.literal: Zai therefore built ramparts on the water outside the city and they faced each other several tens of days.
translations.idiomatic: Zai built water ramparts outside the city and they faced each other for weeks.

sentences.zh: 杜龕遣其從弟北叟將兵拒戰，北叟敗，歸於義興。

translations.literal: Du Kan sent his younger cousin Beisou to lead troops to resist; Beisou was defeated and returned to Yixing.
translations.idiomatic: Du Kan sent his cousin Beisou to fight; Beisou was beaten and fled to Yixing.

sentences.zh: 霸先聞文育軍不利，辛未，自表東討，留高州刺史侯安都、石州刺史杜稜宿衛台省。

translations.literal: Baxian heard Wenyu's army was faring ill; on xinwei he memorialized to campaign east in person, leaving Gaozhou Inspector Hou Andu and Shizhou Inspector Du Ling to guard the capital offices.
translations.idiomatic: Hearing Wenyu's army was failing, on xinwei Baxian memorialized to campaign east in person, leaving Hou Andu and Du Ling to guard the capital.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，軍至義興，丙子，拔其水柵。

translations.literal: On jiaxu his army reached Yixing; on bingzi he took the water ramparts.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu his army reached Yixing; on bingzi he took the water ramparts.

sentences.zh: 譙、秦二州刺史徐嗣徽從弟嗣先，僧辯之甥也。

translations.literal: Qiao and Qin provinces' Inspector Xu Sihui's younger cousin Suxian, Senbian's nephew by his sister.
translations.idiomatic: Qiao and Qin provinces' inspector Xu Sihui's cousin Suxian was Senbian's nephew.

sentences.zh: 僧辯死，嗣先亡就嗣徽，嗣徽以州入於齊。

translations.literal: When Senbian died, Suxian fled to Sihui; Sihui surrendered the province to Qi.
translations.idiomatic: When Senbian died, Suxian fled to Sihui; Sihui surrendered the province to Northern Qi.

sentences.zh: 及陳霸先東討義興，嗣徽密結南豫州刺史任約，將精兵五千乘虛襲建康，是日，入據石頭，游騎至闕下。

translations.literal: When Chen Baxian campaigned east against Yixing, Sihui secretly joined South Yuzhou Inspector Ren Yue, led five thousand crack troops to strike Jiankang by surprise, and that day entered and held Stone City; roaming horse reached below the palace gates.
translations.idiomatic: When Chen Baxian marched east on Yixing, Sihui secretly joined South Yuzhou inspector Ren Yue, led five thousand crack troops in a surprise strike on Jiankang, entered Stone City that day, and roaming horse reached the palace gates.

sentences.zh: 侯安都閉門藏旗幟，示之以弱，令城中曰：「登陴窺賊者斬！

translations.literal: Hou Andu closed the gates and hid banners, showed weakness, and ordered within the city: "Whoever mounts the wall to spy on the enemy—beheaded!
translations.idiomatic: Hou Andu shut the gates, hid the banners, feigned weakness, and ordered: "Whoever mounts the wall to spy on the enemy dies!

sentences.zh: 」及夕，嗣徽等收兵還石頭。

translations.literal: " By evening, Sihui and the others gathered their troops and returned to Stone City.
translations.idiomatic: " By evening, Sihui and the others withdrew their troops to Stone City.

sentences.zh: 安都夜為戰備，將旦，嗣徽等又至，安都帥甲士三百開東、西掖門出戰，大破之，嗣徽等奔還石頭，不敢復逼台城。

translations.literal: Andu made night preparations for battle; near dawn Sihui and the others came again; Andu led three hundred armored men, opened the eastern and western side gates, and went out to fight, routing them greatly; Sihui and the others fled back to Stone City and dared not press the capital again.
translations.idiomatic: Andu prepared through the night; near dawn Sihui came again; Andu led three hundred armored men out the eastern and western side gates, routed them, and they fled to Stone City and dared not press the capital again.

sentences.zh: 陳霸先遣韋載族弟翽繼書諭載，丁丑，載及杜北叟皆降，霸先厚撫之，以翽監義興郡，引載置左右，與之謀議。

translations.literal: Chen Baxian sent Wei Zai's clansman Hui with repeated letters to persuade Zai; on dingchou Zai and Du Beisou both surrendered; Baxian treated them generously, made Hui oversee Yixing Commandery, and kept Zai at his side for counsel.
translations.idiomatic: Baxian sent Wei Zai's clansman Hui with letters to persuade him; on dingchou Zai and Du Beisou surrendered; Baxian treated them well, put Hui in charge of Yixing, and kept Zai at his side for counsel.

sentences.zh: 霸先卷甲還建康，使周文育討杜龕，救長城。

translations.literal: Baxian rolled up armor and returned to Jiankang, sent Zhou Wenyu against Du Kan, and rescued Changcheng.
translations.idiomatic: Baxian rolled up armor and returned to Jiankang, sent Zhou Wenyu against Du Kan, and relieved Changcheng.

sentences.zh: 將軍黃他攻王僧智於吳郡，不克，霸先使寧遠將軍裴忌助之。

translations.literal: General Huang Ta attacked Wang Sengzhi in Wu Commandery but could not overcome him; Baxian sent Pacification-Far General Pei Ji to help.
translations.idiomatic: General Huang Ta attacked Wang Sengzhi in Wu Commandery but could not take him; Baxian sent pacification-far general Pei Ji to help.

sentences.zh: 忌選所部精兵輕行倍道，自錢塘直趣吳郡，夜，至城下，鼓噪薄之。

translations.literal: Ji chose crack troops from his command, marched light and double-quick from Qiantang straight at Wu Commandery; at night he reached below the wall, drummed and shouted, and pressed close.
translations.idiomatic: Ji chose crack troops, marched light and double-quick from Qiantang straight at Wu Commandery, reached the wall at night, drummed and shouted, and pressed close.

sentences.zh: 僧智以為大軍至，輕舟奔吳興。

translations.literal: Sengzhi thought the great army had arrived, fled in a light boat to Wuxing.
translations.idiomatic: Sengzhi thought the main army had arrived and fled by light boat to Wuxing.

sentences.zh: 忌入據吳郡，因以忌為太守。

translations.literal: Ji entered and held Wu Commandery, and Baxian made Ji administrator.
translations.idiomatic: Ji entered and held Wu Commandery, and Baxian made Ji administrator.

sentences.zh: 十一月，己卯，齊遣兵五千度江據姑孰，以應徐嗣徽、任約。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on jimao, Qi sent five thousand men across the river to hold Gudu in answer to Xu Sihui and Ren Yue.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on jimao, Northern Qi sent five thousand men across the river to hold Gudu in support of Xu Sihui and Ren Yue.

sentences.zh: 陳霸先使合州刺史徐度立柵於冶城。

translations.literal: Chen Baxian sent Hezhou Inspector Xu Du to build ramparts at Yecheng.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Baxian sent Hezhou inspector Xu Du to build ramparts at Yecheng.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，齊又遣安州刺史翟子崇、楚州刺史劉士榮、淮州刺史柳達摩將兵萬人於胡墅度米三萬石、馬千匹入石頭。

translations.literal: On gengchen, Qi again sent Anzhou Inspector Zhai Zichong, Chuzhou Inspector Liu Shirong, and Huaizhou Inspector Liu Damo to lead ten thousand men at Hushu to ferry thirty thousand shi of grain and a thousand horses into Stone City.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, Northern Qi again sent Zhai Zichong of Anzhou, Liu Shirong of Chuzhou, and Liu Damo of Huaizhou with ten thousand men at Hushu to ferry thirty thousand shi of grain and a thousand horses into Stone City.

sentences.zh: 霸先問計於韋載。

translations.literal: Baxian asked Wei Zai for a plan.
translations.idiomatic: Baxian asked Wei Zai for a plan.

sentences.zh: 載曰：「齊師若分兵先據三吳之路，略地東境，則時事去矣。

translations.literal: Zai said: "If Qi troops first divide forces to hold the roads of the Three Wu and overrun the eastern marches, the times are lost.
translations.idiomatic: Zai said: "If Northern Qi troops first seize the roads of the Three Wu and overrun the eastern marches, the game is lost.

sentences.zh: 今可急於淮南因侯景故壘築城，以通東道轉輸，分兵絕彼之糧運，使進無所資，則齊將之首旬日可致。

translations.literal: Now you should hurry south of the Huai on Hou Jing's old ramparts to build a city, open the eastern route for transport, and detach troops to cut their grain supply—then without resources for advance, Qi generals' heads can be had in ten days."
translations.idiomatic: Hurry south of the Huai on Hou Jing's old ramparts, open the eastern supply route, and cut their grain—without supplies, Northern Qi generals' heads can be had in ten days."

sentences.zh: 」霸先從之。
癸未，使侯安都夜襲胡墅，燒齊船千餘艘；

translations.literal: On guimao, he had Hou Andu raid Hushu by night and burn more than a thousand Qi ships;
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, he had Hou Andu raid Hushu by night and burn more than a thousand Northern Qi ships;

sentences.zh: 仁威將軍周鐵虎斷齊運輸，擒其北徐州刺史張領州；

translations.literal: Benevolent-Power General Zhou Tiehu cut Qi's transport and captured its Beixuzhou Inspector Zhang Lingzhou;
translations.idiomatic: Benevolent-power general Zhou Tiehu cut Northern Qi's supply line and captured Beixuzhou inspector Zhang Lingzhou;

sentences.zh: 仍遣韋載於大航築侯景故壘，使杜稜守之。

translations.literal: he also sent Wei Zai to build on Hou Jing's old rampart at Dahang and had Du Ling hold it.
translations.idiomatic: he also sent Wei Zai to rebuild Hou Jing's old rampart at Dahang and had Du Ling hold it.

sentences.zh: 齊人於倉門、水南立二柵，與梁兵相拒。

translations.literal: Qi men built two ramparts at Cangmen and south of the water to resist Liang troops.
translations.idiomatic: Northern Qi built two ramparts at Cangmen and south of the water to resist Liang.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，齊大都督蕭軌將兵屯江北。

translations.literal: On renchen, Qi's Grand Commander Xiao Gui led troops encamped north of the river.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, Northern Qi's grand commander Xiao Gui encamped north of the river.

sentences.zh: 初，齊平秦王歸彥幼孤，高祖令清河昭武王岳養之，岳情禮甚薄，歸彥心銜之。

translations.literal: At first Prince Guiyan of Pingqin of Qi was orphaned young; Gaozu had Prince Zhaowu Yue of Qinghe rear him; Yue's affection and courtesy were very thin and Guiyan bore a grudge.
translations.idiomatic: At first Prince Guiyan of Pingqin of Northern Qi was orphaned young; Gao Zu had Prince Zhaowu Yue of Qinghe rear him; Yue treated him coldly and Guiyan bore a grudge.

sentences.zh: 及顯祖即位，歸彥為領軍大將軍，大被寵遇，岳謂其德己，更倚賴之。

translations.literal: When Emperor Xianzu took the throne, Guiyan was Palace Guard General, greatly favored; Yue thought he owed him gratitude and relied on him more.
translations.idiomatic: When Gao Yang took the throne, Guiyan was palace guard general and greatly favored; Yue thought he owed him and relied on him more.

sentences.zh: 岳屢將兵立功，有威名，而性豪侈，好酒色，起第於城南，廳事後開巷。

translations.literal: Yue repeatedly led troops to achievement, had a fierce name, but was extravagant by nature, loved wine and women, and built a mansion in the south of the city; behind the main hall he opened a lane.
translations.idiomatic: Yue repeatedly won on campaign and had a fierce name, but was extravagant, loved wine and women, and built a mansion south of the city with a lane behind the main hall.

sentences.zh: 歸彥譖之於帝曰：「清河僭擬宮禁，制為永巷，但無闕耳。

translations.literal: Guiyan slandered him to the emperor, saying: "Qinghe imitates the palace precincts and made an eternal lane—only the towers are missing."
translations.idiomatic: Guiyan slandered him to the emperor: "Qinghe apes the palace and built an eternal lane—only the towers are missing."

sentences.zh: 」帝由是惡之。
帝納倡婦薛氏於後宮，岳先嘗因其姊迎之至第。

translations.literal: The emperor took the courtesan Lady Xue into the rear palace; Yue had once received her through his elder sister at his mansion.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor took the courtesan Lady Xue into the rear palace; Yue had once received her through his sister at his mansion.

sentences.zh: 帝夜遊於薛氏家，其姊為父乞司徒。

translations.literal: The emperor made a night visit to Lady Xue's house; her sister begged the rank of Minister of Education for their father.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor visited Lady Xue's house at night; her sister begged the rank of minister of education for their father.

sentences.zh: 帝大怒，懸其姊，鋸殺之。

translations.literal: The emperor was greatly enraged, hanged her sister, and sawed her to death.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was enraged, hanged her sister, and sawed her to death.

sentences.zh: 讓岳以奸，岳不服，帝益怒，乙亥，使歸彥鴆岳。

translations.literal: He reproached Yue for adultery; Yue would not admit it; the emperor grew angrier; on yihai he had Guiyan poison Yue.
translations.idiomatic: He accused Yue of adultery; Yue denied it; the emperor grew angrier; on yihai he had Guiyan poison Yue.

sentences.zh: 岳自訴無罪，歸彥曰：「飲之則家全。

translations.literal: Yue pleaded his innocence; Guiyan said: "Drink and your household is preserved."
translations.idiomatic: Yue pleaded innocence; Guiyan said: "Drink and your household is preserved."

sentences.zh: 」飲之而卒，葬贈如禮。

translations.literal: " He drank it and died; burial and posthumous honors followed ritual.
translations.idiomatic: " He drank it and died; he was buried and honored posthumously according to rites.

sentences.zh: 薛嬪有寵於帝，久之，帝忽思其與岳通，無故斬首，藏之於懷，出東山宴飲。

translations.literal: Concubine Xue had the emperor's favor; long after, the emperor suddenly remembered her congress with Yue, beheaded her for no cause, hid the head in his bosom, and went out to Dongshan for a feast.
translations.idiomatic: Concubine Xue had the emperor's favor; long after, he suddenly remembered her affair with Yue, beheaded her for no cause, hid the head in his robe, and went to Dongshan to feast.

sentences.zh: 勸酬始合，忽探出其首，投於柈上，支解其屍，弄其髀為琵琶，一座大驚。

translations.literal: When toasts had just joined, he suddenly drew out the head, threw it on a tray, dismembered the corpse, made a lute of the thigh bone, and the whole bench was shocked.
translations.idiomatic: When toasts had just joined, he drew out the head, threw it on a tray, dismembered the corpse, made a lute of the thigh bone, and the whole bench was shocked.

sentences.zh: 帝方收取，對之流涕曰：「佳人難再得！

translations.literal: The emperor was about to take it back and wept facing it: "A fair woman is hard to gain again!
translations.idiomatic: He was about to take it back and wept over it: "A fair woman is hard to gain again!

sentences.zh: 」載屍以出，被發步哭而隨之。

translations.literal: " They carried the corpse out; with hair unbound they walked weeping and followed it.
translations.idiomatic: " They carried the body out; with hair loose they walked weeping behind it.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，徐嗣徽等攻冶城柵，陳霸先將精甲自西明門出擊之，嗣徽等大敗，留柳達摩等守城，自往採石迎齊援。

translations.literal: On jiachen, Xu Sihui and others attacked the Yecheng ramparts; Chen Baxian led crack armor out the Ximing Gate to strike them; Sihui was greatly routed, left Liu Damo and others to hold the city, and himself went to Caishi to welcome Qi reinforcements.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, Xu Sihui attacked the Yecheng ramparts; Chen Baxian led crack troops out the Ximing Gate and routed them; Sihui left Liu Damo to hold the city and went to Caishi to welcome Northern Qi reinforcements.

sentences.zh: 以郢州刺史宜豐侯循為太保，廣州刺史曲江侯勃為司空，並征入侍。

translations.literal: He made Yingzhou Inspector Marquis Xun of Yifeng Grand Tutor and Guangzhou Inspector Marquis Bo of Qujiang Minister of Works, both summoned to attend court.
translations.idiomatic: He made Yingzhou inspector Marquis Xun of Yifeng grand tutor and Guangzhou inspector Marquis Bo of Qujiang minister of works, both summoned to attend court.

sentences.zh: 循受太保而辭不入。

translations.literal: Xun accepted Grand Tutor but declined to enter.
translations.idiomatic: Xun accepted grand tutor but declined to enter.

sentences.zh: 勃方謀舉兵，遂不受命。

translations.literal: Bo was just plotting to raise troops and therefore did not accept the order.
translations.idiomatic: Bo was plotting to raise troops and refused the order.

sentences.zh: 鎮南將軍王琳侵魏，魏大將軍豆盧寧御之。

translations.literal: Garrison-South General Wang Lin invaded Wei; Wei Grand General Dou Lu Ning resisted him.
translations.idiomatic: Garrison-south general Wang Lin invaded Western Wei; grand general Dou Lu Ning resisted him.

sentences.zh: 十二月，癸丑，侯安都襲秦郡，破徐嗣徽柵，俘數百人。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on guichou, Hou Andu raided Qin Commandery, broke Xu Sihui's ramparts, and captured several hundred.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on guichou, Hou Andu raided Qin Commandery, broke Xu Sihui's ramparts, and captured several hundred.

sentences.zh: 收其家，得其琵琶及鷹，遣使送之曰：「昨至弟處得此，今以相還。

translations.literal: Searching his house, they found his pipa and hawk; he sent envoys with them, saying: "Yesterday at your younger brother's place I got these; now I return them.
translations.idiomatic: Searching his house, they found his pipa and hawk; he sent envoys saying: "Yesterday at your brother's I got these; now I return them.

sentences.zh: 」嗣徽大懼。
丙辰，陳霸先對冶城立航，悉渡眾軍，攻其水南二柵。

translations.literal: On bingchen, Chen Baxian built a bridge facing Yecheng, ferried the whole army across, and attacked the two ramparts south of the water.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, Chen Baxian built a bridge facing Yecheng, ferried the whole army across, and attacked the two ramparts south of the water.

sentences.zh: 柳達摩等渡淮置陳，霸先督兵疾戰，縱火燒柵，齊兵大敗，爭舟相擠，溺死者以千數，呼聲震天地，盡收其船艦。

translations.literal: Liu Damo and others crossed the Huai and set battle lines; Baxian supervised troops in swift battle, set fire and burned the ramparts; Qi troops were greatly defeated, struggled for boats and crowded one another, those drowned numbered in the thousands, cries shook heaven and earth, and all their ships were taken.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Damo and others crossed the Huai and set battle lines; Baxian led a swift fight, fired the ramparts; Northern Qi troops were routed, struggled for boats, thousands drowned, cries shook heaven and earth, and all their ships were taken.

sentences.zh: 是日，嗣徽與任約引齊兵水步萬餘人還據石頭，霸先遣兵詣江寧，據險要。

translations.literal: That day Sihui and Ren Yue led more than ten thousand Qi troops by water and land back to hold Stone City; Baxian sent troops to Jiangning to hold the strategic passes.
translations.idiomatic: That day Sihui and Ren Yue led more than ten thousand Northern Qi troops by water and land back to Stone City; Baxian sent troops to Jiangning to hold the strategic passes.

sentences.zh: 嗣徽等水步不敢進。

translations.literal: Sihui and the rest dared not advance by water or land.
translations.idiomatic: Sihui and the rest dared not advance by water or land.

sentences.zh: 頓江寧浦口，霸先遣侯安都將水軍襲破之，嗣徽等單舸脫走，盡收其軍資器械。

translations.literal: They halted at Jiangning's Pukou; Baxian sent Hou Andu to lead the navy in a surprise attack and rout them; Sihui and the rest escaped in single boats; all their military stores and weapons were taken.
translations.idiomatic: They halted at Jiangning's Pukou; Chen Baxian sent Hou Andu to lead the navy in a surprise attack and rout them; Sihui and the rest escaped in single boats, and all their military stores and weapons were taken.

sentences.zh: 己未，霸先四面攻石頭，城中無水，升水直絹一匹。

translations.literal: On jiwei, Baxian attacked Stone City on four sides; the city had no water; a sheng of water cost one bolt of plain silk.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, Chen Baxian attacked Stone City on four sides; the city had no water; a sheng of water cost one bolt of plain silk.

sentences.zh: 庚申，達摩遣使請和於霸先，且求質子。

translations.literal: On gengshen, Damo sent envoys to seek peace with Baxian and also asked for a hostage.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, Liu Damo sent envoys to seek peace with Chen Baxian and also asked for a hostage.

sentences.zh: 時建康虛弱，糧運不繼，朝臣皆欲與齊和，請以霸先從子曇朗為質。

translations.literal: At that time Jiankang was weak and grain transport did not continue; court ministers all wished peace with Qi and asked to send Baxian's nephew Tanlang as hostage.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Jiankang was weak and grain transport had broken down; court ministers all wished peace with Qi and asked to send Chen Baxian's nephew Tanlang as hostage.

sentences.zh: 霸先曰：「今在位諸賢欲息肩於齊，若違眾議，謂孤愛曇朗，不恤國家，今決遣曇朗，棄之寇庭。

translations.literal: Baxian said, "The worthies now in office wish to rest their shoulders under Qi; if I defy the assembly's counsel, they will say I love Tanlang and do not care for the state. I now resolve to send Tanlang away and abandon him in the enemy court.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Baxian said, "The worthies now in office wish to rest their shoulders under Qi; if I defy the assembly's counsel, they will say I love Tanlang and do not care for the state. I now resolve to send Tanlang away and abandon him in the enemy court.

sentences.zh: 齊人無信，謂我微弱，必當背盟。

translations.literal: Qi men are faithless; seeing us weak, they will surely break the covenant.
translations.idiomatic: Qi men are faithless; seeing us weak, they will surely break the covenant.

sentences.zh: 齊寇若來，諸君須為孤力鬥也！

translations.literal: If Qi invaders come, you gentlemen must fight hard for me!
translations.idiomatic: If Qi invaders come, you gentlemen must fight hard for me!

sentences.zh: 」乃以曇朗及永嘉王莊、丹楊尹王沖之子鈱為質，與齊人盟於城外，將士咨其南北。

translations.literal: " He then took Tanlang, Prince Zhuang of Yongjia, and Qian son of Wang Chong, governor of Danyang, as hostages, allied with Qi outside the walls, and officers and soldiers murmured at the north-south arrangement.
translations.idiomatic: " He then took Tanlang, Prince Zhuang of Yongjia, and Qian son of Wang Chong, governor of Danyang, as hostages, allied with Qi outside the walls, and officers and soldiers murmured at the north-south arrangement.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，霸先陳兵石頭南門，送齊人歸北，徐嗣徽、任約皆奔齊。

translations.literal: On xinyou, Baxian arrayed troops at Stone City's south gate, sent Qi men back north; Xu Sihui and Ren Yue both fled to Qi.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, Chen Baxian arrayed troops at Stone City's south gate and sent Qi men back north; Xu Sihui and Ren Yue both fled to Qi.

sentences.zh: 收齊馬仗船米，不可勝計。

translations.literal: Qi horses, weapons, ships, and grain taken were beyond counting.
translations.idiomatic: Qi horses, weapons, ships, and grain taken were beyond counting.

sentences.zh: 齊主誅柳達摩。

translations.literal: The Qi ruler executed Liu Damo.
translations.idiomatic: The Qi ruler executed Liu Damo.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，齊和州長史烏丸遠自南州奔還歷陽。

translations.literal: On renxu, Qi Hezhou chief clerk Wanyuan Yuan fled back to Liyang from the southern commandery.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, Qi Hezhou chief clerk Wanyuan Yuan fled back to Liyang from the southern commandery.

sentences.zh: 江寧令陳嗣、黃門侍郎曹朗據姑孰反，霸先命侯安都等討平之。

translations.literal: Jiangning magistrate Chen Si and Yellow Gate Attendant Cao Lang held Gushu in rebellion; Baxian ordered Hou Andu and others to campaign and pacify them.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangning magistrate Chen Si and yellow gate attendant Cao Lang held Gushu in rebellion; Chen Baxian ordered Hou Andu and others to campaign and pacify them.

sentences.zh: 霸先恐陳曇朗亡竄，自帥步騎至京口迎之。

translations.literal: Baxian feared Chen Tanlang would flee and hide; he himself led foot and horse to Jingkou to meet him.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Baxian feared Chen Tanlang would flee and hide; he himself led foot and horse to Jingkou to meet him.

sentences.zh: 交州刺史劉元偃帥其屬數千人歸王琳。

translations.literal: Jiaozhou Inspector Liu Yuanyan led several thousand of his followers to submit to Wang Lin.
translations.idiomatic: Jiaozhou inspector Liu Yuanyan led several thousand of his followers to submit to Wang Lin.

sentences.zh: 魏以侍中李遠為尚書左僕射。

translations.literal: Wei made Attendant-in-Ordinary Li Yuan Left Vice Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Western Wei made attendant-in-ordinary Li Yuan left vice director of the secretariat.

sentences.zh: 魏益州刺史宇文貴使譙淹從子子嗣誘說淹，以為大將軍，淹不從，斬子嗣。

translations.literal: Wei Yizhou Inspector Yuwen Gui had Qiao Yan's nephew Zisi entice Yan, offering him the title Grand General; Yan would not obey and beheaded Zisi.
translations.idiomatic: Western Wei Yizhou inspector Yuwen Gui had Qiao Yan's nephew Zisi entice Yan, offering him the title grand general; Yan would not obey and beheaded Zisi.

sentences.zh: 貴怒，攻之，淹自東遂寧徙屯墊江。

translations.literal: Gui was angry and attacked him; Yan moved his camp from Dongsuining to Dianjiang.
translations.idiomatic: Gui was angry and attacked him; Yan moved his camp from Dongsuining to Dianjiang.

sentences.zh: 初，晉安民陳羽，世為閩中豪姓，其子寶應多權詐，郡中畏服。

translations.literal: Earlier, Jin'an native Chen Yu, for generations a great clan of Minzhong; his son Baoying was full of schemes and deceit, and the commandery feared and obeyed him.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, Jin'an native Chen Yu, for generations a great clan of Minzhong; his son Baoying was full of schemes and deceit, and the commandery feared and obeyed him.

sentences.zh: 侯景之亂，晉安太守賓化侯雲以郡讓羽，羽老，但治郡事，令寶應典兵。

translations.literal: In Hou Jing's rebellion, Jin'an Inspector Marquis Yun of Binhua yielded the commandery to Yu; Yu was old and only handled commandery affairs, letting Baoying command the troops.
translations.idiomatic: In Hou Jing's rebellion, Jin'an inspector Marquis Yun of Binhua yielded the commandery to Yu; Yu was old and only handled commandery affairs, letting Baoying command the troops.

sentences.zh: 時東境荒饉，而晉安獨豐衍。

translations.literal: At that time the eastern marches were famine-stricken, but Jin'an alone was rich and abundant.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the eastern marches were famine-stricken, but Jin'an alone was rich and abundant.

sentences.zh: 寶應數自海道出，寇抄臨安、永嘉、會稽，或載米粟與之貿易，由是能致富強。

translations.literal: Baoying repeatedly went out by sea routes, raiding Lin'an, Yongjia, and Kuaiji, or carrying grain to trade with them; thereby he grew rich and strong.
translations.idiomatic: Baoying repeatedly went out by sea routes, raiding Lin'an, Yongjia, and Kuaiji, or carrying grain to trade with them; thereby he grew rich and strong.

sentences.zh: 侯景平，世祖因以羽為晉安太守。

translations.literal: When Hou Jing was pacified, Shizu therefore made Yu Jin'an Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: When Hou Jing was pacified, Shizu therefore made Yu Jin'an inspector.

sentences.zh: 及陳霸先輔政，羽求傳郡於寶應，霸先許之。

translations.literal: When Chen Baxian assisted in government, Yu asked to pass the commandery to Baoying; Baxian permitted it.
translations.idiomatic: When Chen Baxian assisted in government, Yu asked to pass the commandery to Baoying; Chen Baxian permitted it.

sentences.zh: 是歲，魏宇文泰諷淮安王育上表請如古制降爵為公，於是宗室諸王皆降為公。

translations.literal: That year, Wei Yuwen Tai prompted Prince Yu of Huai'an to memorialize asking, per ancient regulation, to lower his rank from prince to duke; thereupon all imperial clansmen who were kings were reduced to dukes.
translations.idiomatic: That year, Western Wei's Yuwen Tai prompted Prince Yu of Huai'an to memorialize asking, per ancient regulation, to lower his rank from prince to duke; thereupon all imperial clansmen who were kings were reduced to dukes.

sentences.zh: 突厥木桿可汗擊柔然主鄧叔子，滅之，叔子收其餘燼奔魏。

translations.literal: Tujue Khan Mugan attacked Rouran ruler Deng Shuzi, destroyed him; Shuzi gathered the remaining embers and fled to Wei.
translations.idiomatic: Tujue khan Mugan attacked Rouran ruler Deng Shuzi, destroyed him; Shuzi gathered the remaining embers and fled to Western Wei.

sentences.zh: 木桿西破厭噠，東走契丹，北並契骨，威服塞外諸國。

translations.literal: Mugan west defeated the Yanda, east drove the Khitan, north annexed Qigu, and awed and subdued the states beyond the passes.
translations.idiomatic: Mugan west defeated the Yanda, east drove the Khitan, north annexed Qigu, and awed and subdued the states beyond the passes.

sentences.zh: 其地東自遼海，西至西海，長萬里，南自沙漠以北五六千里皆屬焉。

translations.literal: His territory ran east from Liaohai, west to Xihai, ten thousand li in length; south from the desert northward five or six thousand li all belonged to him.
translations.idiomatic: His territory ran east from Liaohai, west to Xihai, ten thousand li in length; south from the desert northward five or six thousand li all belonged to him.

sentences.zh: 木桿恃其強，請盡誅鄧叔子等於魏，使者相繼於道。

translations.literal: Mugan relied on his strength and asked that Deng Shuzi and his followers all be executed in Wei; envoys followed one another on the road.
translations.idiomatic: Mugan relied on his strength and asked that Deng Shuzi and his followers all be executed in Western Wei; envoys followed one another on the road.

sentences.zh: 太師泰收叔子以下三千餘人付其使者，盡殺之於青門外。

translations.literal: Grand Preceptor Tai took Shuzi and more than three thousand below him and handed them to Mugan's envoys; all were killed outside Qing Gate.
translations.idiomatic: Grand preceptor Yuwen Tai took Shuzi and more than three thousand below him and handed them to Mugan's envoys; all were killed outside Qing Gate.

sentences.zh: 初，魏太師泰以漢、魏官繁，命蘇綽及尚書令盧辯依《周禮》更定六官。

translations.literal: Earlier, Wei Grand Preceptor Tai, because Han and Wei offices were numerous, ordered Su Chuo and Secretariat Director Lu Bian to revise the six offices according to the Rites of Zhou.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, Western Wei grand preceptor Yuwen Tai, because Han and Wei offices were numerous, ordered Su Chuo and secretariat director Lu Bian to revise the six offices according to the Rites of Zhou.

sentences.zh: 敬皇帝太平元年（

translations.literal: Emperor Jing, first year of Taiping (
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Jing, first year of Taiping (

sentences.zh: 丙子，公元五五六年）

translations.literal: bingzi, AD 556)
translations.idiomatic: bingzi, AD 556)

sentences.zh: 春，正月，丁丑，魏初建六官，以宇文泰為太師、大塚宰，柱國李弼為太傅、大司徒，趙貴為太保、大宗伯，獨孤信為大司馬，於謹為大司寇，侯莫陳崇為大司空。

translations.literal: Spring, first month, on dingchou, Wei first established the six offices: Yuwen Tai as Grand Preceptor and Grand Chief Minister, pillar of state Li Bi as Grand Tutor and Grand Minister of Education, Zhao Gui as Grand Guardian and Grand Director of the Masses, Dugu Xin as Grand Marshal, Yu Jin as Grand Judge, Houmochen Chong as Grand Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: Spring, first month, on dingchou, Western Wei first established the six offices: Yuwen Tai as grand preceptor and grand chief minister, pillar of state Li Bi as grand tutor and grand minister of education, Zhao Gui as grand guardian and grand director of the masses, Dugu Xin as grand marshal, Yu Jin as grand judge, Houmochen Chong as grand minister of works.

sentences.zh: 自餘百官，皆仿《周禮》。

translations.literal: All remaining officials likewise followed the Rites of Zhou.
translations.idiomatic: All remaining officials likewise followed the Rites of Zhou.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，大赦，其與任約、徐嗣徽同謀者，一無所問。

translations.literal: On wuyin, a general amnesty; those who had conspired with Ren Yue and Xu Sihui were not questioned at all.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, a general amnesty; those who had conspired with Ren Yue and Xu Sihui were not questioned at all.

sentences.zh: 癸未，陳霸先使從事中郎江旰說徐嗣徽使南歸，嗣徽執旰送齊。

translations.literal: On guiwei, Chen Baxian sent Attendant Gentleman Jiang Gan to persuade Xu Sihui to return south; Sihui seized Gan and sent him to Qi.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, Chen Baxian sent attendant gentleman Jiang Gan to persuade Xu Sihui to return south; Sihui seized Gan and sent him to Qi.

sentences.zh: 陳茜、周文育合軍攻杜龕於吳興。

translations.literal: Chen Qian and Zhou Wenyu united armies to attack Du Kan at Wuxing.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Qian and Zhou Wenyu united armies to attack Du Kan at Wuxing.

sentences.zh: 龕勇而無謀，嗜酒常醉，其將杜泰陰與茜等通。

translations.literal: Kan was brave but without strategy, loved wine and was often drunk; his general Du Tai secretly communicated with Qian and the rest.
translations.idiomatic: Kan was brave but without strategy, loved wine and was often drunk; his general Du Tai secretly communicated with Qian and the rest.

sentences.zh: 龕與茜等戰，敗，泰因說龕使降，龕然之。

translations.literal: Kan fought Qian and the rest, was defeated; Tai thereupon urged Kan to surrender, and Kan agreed.
translations.idiomatic: Kan fought Qian and the rest, was defeated; Tai thereupon urged Kan to surrender, and Kan agreed.

sentences.zh: 其妻王氏曰：「霸先仇隙如此，何可求和！

translations.literal: His wife Lady Wang said, "Baxian's enmity is so deep—how can we seek peace!
translations.idiomatic: His wife Lady Wang said, "Chen Baxian's enmity is so deep—how can we seek peace!

sentences.zh: 」因出私財賞募，復擊茜等，大破之。

translations.literal: " She then brought out private wealth to reward recruits, again struck Qian and the rest, and routed them.
translations.idiomatic: " She then brought out private wealth to reward recruits, again struck Qian and the rest, and routed them.

sentences.zh: 既而杜泰降於茜，龕尚醉未覺，茜遣人負出，於項王寺前斬之。

translations.literal: Before long Du Tai surrendered to Qian; Kan was still drunk and unaware; Qian had men carry him out and beheaded him before Xiangwang Temple.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Du Tai surrendered to Qian; Kan was still drunk and unaware; Qian had men carry him out and beheaded him before Xiangwang Temple.

sentences.zh: 王僧智與其弟豫章太守僧愔俱奔齊。

translations.literal: Wang Sengzhi and his younger brother, Yuzhang Inspector Sengyin, both fled to Qi.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Sengzhi and his younger brother, Yuzhang inspector Sengyin, both fled to Qi.

sentences.zh: 東揚州刺史張彪素為王僧辯所厚，不附霸先。

translations.literal: Dongyang Inspector Zhang Biao had long been favored by Wang Senbian and did not attach himself to Baxian.
translations.idiomatic: Dongyang inspector Zhang Biao had long been favored by Wang Senbian and did not attach himself to Chen Baxian.

sentences.zh: 二月，庚戌，陳茜、周文育輕兵襲會稽，彪兵敗，走入若邪山中，茜遣其將吳興章昭遠追斬之。

translations.literal: Second month, on gengxu, Chen Qian and Zhou Wenyu with light troops surprised Kuaiji; Biao's army was defeated; he fled into the Ruoye Mountains; Qian sent his general Zhang Zhaoyuan of Wuxing to pursue and behead him.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, on gengxu, Chen Qian and Zhou Wenyu with light troops surprised Kuaiji; Biao's army was defeated; he fled into the Ruoye Mountains; Qian sent his general Zhang Zhaoyuan of Wuxing to pursue and behead him.

sentences.zh: 東陽太守留異饋茜糧食，霸先以異為縉州刺史。

translations.literal: Dongyang Inspector Liu Yi sent grain to Qian; Baxian made Yi Inspector of Jinyang.
translations.idiomatic: Dongyang inspector Liu Yi sent grain to Qian; Chen Baxian made Yi inspector of Jinyang.

sentences.zh: 江州刺史侯瑱本事王僧辯，亦擁兵據豫章及江州，不附霸先。

translations.literal: Jingzhou Inspector Hou Tian had long served Wang Senbian; he also held troops and occupied Yuzhang and Jingzhou, not attaching himself to Baxian.
translations.idiomatic: Jingzhou inspector Hou Tian had long served Wang Senbian; he also held troops and occupied Yuzhang and Jingzhou, not attaching himself to Chen Baxian.

sentences.zh: 霸先以周文育為南豫州刺史，使將兵擊湓城，庚申，又遣侯安都、周鐵虎將舟師立柵於梁山，以備江州。

translations.literal: Baxian made Zhou Wenyu Southern Yuzhou Inspector and sent him to lead troops against Pencheng; on gengshen he also sent Hou Andu and Zhou Tiehu to lead the fleet and build palisades at Liangshan to guard against Jingzhou.
