translations.idiomatic: Chen Baxian made Zhou Wenyu southern Yuzhou inspector and sent him to lead troops against Pencheng; on gengshen he also sent Hou Andu and Zhou Tiehu to lead the fleet and build palisades at Liangshan to guard against Jingzhou.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，徐嗣徽、任約襲採石，執戍主明州刺史張懷鈞送於齊。

translations.literal: On guihai, Xu Sihui and Ren Yue raided Caishi, seized the garrison chief, Mingzhou Inspector Zhang Huaijun, and sent him to Qi.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, Xu Sihui and Ren Yue raided Caishi, seized the garrison chief, Mingzhou inspector Zhang Huaijun, and sent him to Qi.

sentences.zh: 後梁主擊侯平於公安，平與長沙王韶引兵還長沙。

translations.literal: The Later Liang ruler attacked Hou Ping at Gong'an; Ping and Prince Shao of Changsha led troops back to Changsha.
translations.idiomatic: The Later Liang ruler attacked Hou Ping at Gong'an; Ping and Prince Shao of Changsha led troops back to Changsha.

sentences.zh: 王琳遣平鎮巴州。

translations.literal: Wang Lin sent Ping to garrison Bazhou.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Lin sent Ping to garrison Bazhou.

sentences.zh: 三月，壬午，詔雜用古今錢。

translations.literal: Third month, on renwu, an edict ordered mixed use of ancient and modern coin.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, on renwu, an edict ordered mixed use of ancient and modern coin.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，齊遣儀同三司蕭軌、庫狄伏連、堯難宗、東方老等與任約、徐嗣徽合兵十萬入寇，出柵口，向梁山。

translations.literal: On wuxu, Qi sent Palace Attendants of the Third Rank Xiao Gui, Kudil Fulian, Yao Nazong, Dongfang Lao, and others with Ren Yue and Xu Sihui—combined armies of one hundred thousand—to invade, exiting Zhashu toward Liangshan.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, Qi sent palace attendants of the third rank Xiao Gui, Kudil Fulian, Yao Nazong, Dongfang Lao, and others with Ren Yue and Xu Sihui—combined armies of one hundred thousand—to invade, exiting Zhashu toward Liangshan.

sentences.zh: 陳霸先帳內蕩主黃叢逆擊，破之，齊師退保蕪湖。

translations.literal: Chen Baxian's tent guard Huang Cong struck them in counterattack and routed them; Qi troops withdrew to hold Wuhu.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Baxian's tent guard Huang Cong struck them in counterattack and routed them; Qi troops withdrew to hold Wuhu.

sentences.zh: 霸先遣定州刺史沈泰等就侯安都，共據梁山以御之。

translations.literal: Baxian sent Dingzhou Inspector Shen Tai and others to join Hou Andu and together hold Liangshan to resist them.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Baxian sent Dingzhou inspector Shen Tai and others to join Hou Andu and together hold Liangshan to resist them.

sentences.zh: 周文育攻湓城，未克，召之還。

translations.literal: Zhou Wenyu attacked Pencheng but did not take it; he was recalled.
translations.idiomatic: Zhou Wenyu attacked Pencheng but did not take it; he was recalled.

sentences.zh: 夏，四月，丁巳，霸先如梁山巡撫諸軍。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, on dingsi, Baxian went to Liangshan to inspect and comfort the armies.
translations.idiomatic: Summer, fourth month, on dingsi, Chen Baxian went to Liangshan to inspect and comfort the armies.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，齊儀同三司婁睿討魯陽蠻，破之。

translations.literal: On yichou, Qi Palace Attendant of the Third Rank Lou Rui campaigned against the Luyang Man and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, Qi palace attendant of the third rank Lou Rui campaigned against the Luyang Man and defeated them.

sentences.zh: 侯安都輕兵襲齊行台司馬恭於歷陽，大破之，俘獲萬計。

translations.literal: Hou Andu with light troops surprised Qi field headquarters commander Sima Gong at Liyang, routed him, and captives numbered in the tens of thousands.
translations.idiomatic: Hou Andu with light troops surprised Qi field headquarters commander Sima Gong at Liyang, routed him, and captives numbered in the tens of thousands.

sentences.zh: 魏太師泰尚孝武妹馮翊公主，生略陽公覺；

translations.literal: Wei Grand Preceptor Tai married Emperor Xiaowu's younger sister, Princess of Fengyi, and begot Duke Jue of Lueyang;
translations.idiomatic: Western Wei grand preceptor Yuwen Tai married Emperor Xiaowu's younger sister, Princess of Fengyi, and begot Duke Jue of Lueyang;

sentences.zh: 姚夫人生寧都公毓。

translations.literal: Lady Yao bore Duke Yu of Ningdu.
translations.idiomatic: Lady Yao bore Duke Yu of Ningdu.

sentences.zh: 毓於諸子最長，娶大司馬獨孤信女。

translations.literal: Yu was eldest among the sons and married Grand Marshal Dugu Xin's daughter.
translations.idiomatic: Yu was eldest among the sons and married grand marshal Dugu Xin's daughter.

sentences.zh: 泰將立嗣，謂公卿曰：「孤欲立子以嫡，恐大司馬有疑，如何？

translations.literal: Tai was about to establish an heir and said to the dukes and ministers, "I wish to establish a son by the principal wife; I fear the Grand Marshal may have doubts—what is to be done?
translations.idiomatic: Yuwen Tai was about to establish an heir and said to the dukes and ministers, "I wish to establish a son by the principal wife; I fear the grand marshal may have doubts—what is to be done?

sentences.zh: 」眾默然，未有言者。

translations.literal: " The assembly was silent; no one spoke.
translations.idiomatic: " The assembly was silent; no one spoke.

sentences.zh: 尚書左僕射李遠曰：「夫立子以嫡不以長，略陽公為世子，公何所疑！

translations.literal: Left Vice Director of the Secretariat Li Yuan said, "In establishing a son, one takes the principal wife's son, not the eldest—Duke Jue of Lueyang should be heir apparent; what doubt has Your Grace!
translations.idiomatic: Left vice director of the secretariat Li Yuan said, "In establishing a son, one takes the principal wife's son, not the eldest—Duke Jue of Lueyang should be heir apparent; what doubt has Your Grace!

sentences.zh: 若以信為嫌，請先斬之。

translations.literal: If you take Xin as the difficulty, I ask first to behead him.
translations.idiomatic: If you take Xin as the difficulty, I ask first to behead him.

sentences.zh: 」遂拔刀而起。

translations.literal: " He thereupon drew his sword and rose.
translations.idiomatic: " He thereupon drew his sword and rose.

sentences.zh: 泰亦起，曰：「何至於是！

translations.literal: Tai also rose and said, "Why go so far!
translations.idiomatic: Yuwen Tai also rose and said, "Why go so far!

sentences.zh: 」信又自陳解，遠乃止。

translations.literal: " Xin again explained himself; Yuan then stopped.
translations.idiomatic: " Xin again explained himself; Yuan then stopped.

sentences.zh: 於是群公並從遠議。

translations.literal: Thereupon all the lords followed Yuan's counsel.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon all the lords followed Yuan's counsel.

sentences.zh: 遠出外，拜謝信曰：「臨大事不得不爾！

translations.literal: Yuan went outside and bowed in apology to Xin, saying, "Facing a great matter, one cannot do otherwise!
translations.idiomatic: Yuan went outside and bowed in apology to Xin, saying, "Facing a great matter, one cannot do otherwise!

sentences.zh: 」信亦謝遠曰：「今日賴公決此大議。

translations.literal: " Xin also thanked Yuan, saying, "Today I rely on you to settle this great deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: " Xin also thanked Yuan, saying, "Today I rely on you to settle this great deliberation.

sentences.zh: 」遂立覺為世子。

translations.literal: " Jue was then established as heir apparent.
translations.idiomatic: " Jue was then established as heir apparent.

sentences.zh: 太師泰北巡。

translations.literal: Grand Preceptor Tai toured north.
translations.idiomatic: Grand preceptor Yuwen Tai toured north.

sentences.zh: 五月，齊人召建安公淵明，詐許退師，陳霸先具舟送之。

translations.literal: Fifth month, Qi men summoned Prince Yuanming of Jian'an, falsely promising to withdraw; Chen Baxian prepared boats and sent him off.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, Qi men summoned Prince Yuanming of Jian'an, falsely promising to withdraw; Chen Baxian prepared boats and sent him off.

sentences.zh: 癸未，淵明疽發背卒。

translations.literal: On guiwei, Yuanming died of a carbuncle on his back.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, Yuanming died of a carbuncle on his back.

sentences.zh: 甲申，齊兵發蕪湖，庚寅，入丹楊縣，丙申，至秣稜故治。

translations.literal: On jiashen, Qi troops set out from Wuhu; on gengyin they entered Danyang County; on bingshen they reached the old seat of Moling.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, Qi troops set out from Wuhu; on gengyin they entered Danyang County; on bingshen they reached the old seat of Moling.

sentences.zh: 陳霸先遣周文育屯方山，徐度頓馬牧，杜稜頓大航南以御之。

translations.literal: Chen Baxian sent Zhou Wenyu to encamp at Fangshan, Xu Du to hold Mapu, and Du Ling to hold south of the Great Crossing to resist them.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Baxian sent Zhou Wenyu to encamp at Fangshan, Xu Du to hold Mapu, and Du Ling to hold south of the Great Crossing to resist them.

sentences.zh: 齊漢陽敬懷王洽卒。

translations.literal: Qi Prince Zhi of Hanyang, posthumous Jinghuai, died.
translations.idiomatic: Qi Prince Zhi of Hanyang, posthumous Jinghuai, died.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，齊人跨淮，立橋柵渡兵，夜至方山。

translations.literal: On xinchou, Qi men crossed the Huai, built bridge palisades to ferry troops, and by night reached Fangshan.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, Qi men crossed the Huai, built bridge palisades to ferry troops, and by night reached Fangshan.

sentences.zh: 徐嗣徽等列艦於青墩，至於七磯，以斷周文育歸路。

translations.literal: Xu Sihui and the rest arrayed ships from Qingdun to Qiji to cut off Zhou Wenyu's route of return.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Sihui and the rest arrayed ships from Qingdun to Qiji to cut off Zhou Wenyu's route of return.

sentences.zh: 文育鼓噪而發，嗣徽等不能制；

translations.literal: Wenyu set out with drums and shouts; Sihui and the rest could not control him;
translations.idiomatic: Wenyu set out with drums and shouts; Sihui and the rest could not control him;

sentences.zh: 至旦，反攻嗣徽。

translations.literal: by dawn he turned and attacked Sihui.
translations.idiomatic: by dawn he turned and attacked Sihui.

sentences.zh: 嗣徽驍將鮑砰獨以小艦殿軍，文育乘單舴艋與戰，跳入艦中，斬砰，仍牽其艦而還。

translations.literal: Sihui's fierce general Bao Peng alone with a small ship brought up the rear; Wenyu rode a single skiff to fight, leaped into the ship, beheaded Peng, and still towed the ship back.
translations.idiomatic: Sihui's fierce general Bao Peng alone with a small ship brought up the rear; Wenyu rode a single skiff to fight, leaped into the ship, beheaded Peng, and still towed the ship back.

sentences.zh: 嗣徽眾大駭，因留船蕪湖，自丹楊步上。

translations.literal: Sihui's host was greatly terrified; they therefore left the ships at Wuhu and went up on foot from Danyang.
translations.idiomatic: Sihui's host was greatly terrified; they therefore left the ships at Wuhu and went up on foot from Danyang.

sentences.zh: 陳霸先追侯安都、徐度皆還。

translations.literal: Chen Baxian recalled Hou Andu and Xu Du.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Baxian recalled Hou Andu and Xu Du.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，齊兵自方山進及倪塘，游騎至台，建康震駭。

translations.literal: On guimao, Qi troops advanced from Fangshan to Nitang; roaming horsemen reached the capital; Jiankang was shaken with terror.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, Qi troops advanced from Fangshan to Nitang; roaming horsemen reached the capital; Jiankang was shaken with terror.

sentences.zh: 帝總禁兵出頓長樂寺，內外纂嚴。

translations.literal: The emperor gathered the palace guard and went out to encamp at Changle Temple; inside and outside were put on strict alert.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor gathered the palace guard and went out to encamp at Changle Temple; inside and outside were put on strict alert.

sentences.zh: 霸先拒嗣徽等於白城，適與周文育會。

translations.literal: Baxian resisted Sihui and the rest at Baicheng, just meeting Zhou Wenyu.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Baxian resisted Sihui and the rest at Baicheng, just meeting Zhou Wenyu.

sentences.zh: 將戰，風急，霸先曰：「兵不逆風。

translations.literal: About to fight, the wind was fierce; Baxian said, "Troops do not go against the wind.
translations.idiomatic: About to fight, the wind was fierce; Chen Baxian said, "Troops do not go against the wind.

sentences.zh: 」文育曰：「事急矣，何用古法！

translations.literal: " Wenyu said, "The matter is urgent—what use is ancient method!
translations.idiomatic: " Wenyu said, "The matter is urgent—what use is ancient method!

sentences.zh: 」抽槊上馬先進，眾軍從之，風亦尋轉，殺傷數百人。

translations.literal: " He drew his spear, mounted, and advanced first; the armies followed; the wind soon shifted; several hundred were killed and wounded.
translations.idiomatic: " He drew his spear, mounted, and advanced first; the armies followed; the wind soon shifted; several hundred were killed and wounded.

sentences.zh: 侯安都與嗣徽等戰於耕壇南，安都帥十二騎突其陳，破之，生擒齊儀同三司乞伏無勞。

translations.literal: Hou Andu fought Sihui and the rest south of Gengtan; Andu led twelve horsemen in a charge through their battle line, routed them, and took alive Qi Palace Attendant of the Third Rank Qifu Wulao.
translations.idiomatic: Hou Andu fought Sihui and the rest south of Gengtan; Andu led twelve horsemen in a charge through their battle line, routed them, and took alive Qi palace attendant of the third rank Qifu Wulao.

sentences.zh: 霸先潛撤精卒三千配沈泰渡江，襲齊行台趙彥深於瓜步，獲艦百餘艘，粟萬斛。

translations.literal: Baxian secretly withdrew three thousand picked troops, assigned them to Shen Tai to cross the river, and raided Qi field headquarters commander Zhao Yanshen at Guabu; more than a hundred ships and ten thousand hu of grain were taken.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Baxian secretly withdrew three thousand picked troops, assigned them to Shen Tai to cross the river, and raided Qi field headquarters commander Zhao Yanshen at Guabu; more than a hundred ships and ten thousand hu of grain were taken.

sentences.zh: 六月，甲辰，齊兵潛至鐘山，侯安都與齊將王敬寶戰於龍尾，軍主張纂戰死。

translations.literal: Sixth month, on jiachen, Qi troops secretly reached Zhongshan; Hou Andu fought Qi general Wang Jingbao at Longwei; army commander Zhang Zuan died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, on jiachen, Qi troops secretly reached Zhongshan; Hou Andu fought Qi general Wang Jingbao at Longwei; army commander Zhang Zuan died in battle.

sentences.zh: 丁未，齊師至幕府山，霸先遣別將錢明將水軍出江乘，邀擊齊人糧運，盡獲其船米。

translations.literal: On dingwei, Qi armies reached Mufu Mountain; Baxian sent detached general Qian Ming to lead the navy out from Jiangcheng, intercept Qi grain transport, and take all their ships and grain.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, Qi armies reached Mufu Mountain; Chen Baxian sent detached general Qian Ming to lead the navy out from Jiangcheng, intercept Qi grain transport, and take all their ships and grain.

sentences.zh: 齊軍乏食，殺馬驢食之。

translations.literal: Qi armies lacked food and killed horses and donkeys to eat.
translations.idiomatic: Qi armies lacked food and killed horses and donkeys to eat.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，齊軍逾鐘山，霸先與眾軍分頓樂游苑東及覆舟山北，斷其衝要。

translations.literal: On gengxu, Qi armies crossed Zhongshan; Baxian and the mass of armies separately encamped east of Leyou Park and north of Fuzhou Mountain, cutting their vital routes.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, Qi armies crossed Zhongshan; Chen Baxian and the mass of armies separately encamped east of Leyou Park and north of Fuzhou Mountain, cutting their vital routes.

sentences.zh: 壬子，齊軍至玄武湖西北，將據北郊壇，眾軍自覆舟東移頓壇北，與齊人相對。

translations.literal: On renzi, Qi armies reached the northwest of Xuanwu Lake, about to seize the Northern Suburban Altar; the mass of armies shifted from east of Fuzhou to encamp north of the altar, facing Qi men.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, Qi armies reached the northwest of Xuanwu Lake, about to seize the Northern Suburban Altar; the mass of armies shifted from east of Fuzhou to encamp north of the altar, facing Qi men.

sentences.zh: 會連日大雨，平地水丈餘，齊軍晝夜坐立泥中，足指皆爛，懸鬲以爨，而台中及潮溝北路燥，梁軍每得番易。

translations.literal: It happened that rain fell for days; standing water in the flatlands was more than a zhang; Qi armies day and night sat and stood in mud, toes all rotted, hung cauldrons to cook; but within the capital and north of Chaogou Road were dry, and Liang armies could rotate shifts.
translations.idiomatic: It happened that rain fell for days; standing water in the flatlands was more than a zhang; Qi armies day and night sat and stood in mud, toes all rotted, hung cauldrons to cook; but within the capital and north of Chaogou Road were dry, and Liang armies could rotate shifts.

sentences.zh: 時四方壅隔，糧運不至，建康戶口流散，徵求無所。

translations.literal: At that time the four quarters were blocked and cut off; grain transport did not arrive; Jiankang households scattered; levies had nowhere to come from.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the four quarters were blocked and cut off; grain transport did not arrive; Jiankang households scattered; levies had nowhere to come from.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，少霽，霸先將戰，調市人得麥飯，分給軍士，士皆饑疲。

translations.literal: On jiayin, the sky cleared a little; Baxian was about to fight; he levied the market people for wheat rice and distributed it to the soldiers; the troops were all hungry and weary.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, the sky cleared a little; Chen Baxian was about to fight; he levied the market people for wheat rice and distributed it to the soldiers; the troops were all hungry and weary.

sentences.zh: 會陳茜饋米三千斛、鴨千頭，霸先命炊米煮鴨，人人以荷葉裹飯，緄以鴨肉數臠。

translations.literal: Just then Chen Qian sent three thousand hu of rice and a thousand ducks; Baxian ordered rice cooked and ducks boiled; each man wrapped rice in lotus leaves and bound in several slices of duck.
translations.idiomatic: Just then Chen Qian sent three thousand hu of rice and a thousand ducks; Chen Baxian ordered rice cooked and ducks boiled; each man wrapped rice in lotus leaves and bound in several slices of duck.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，未明，蓐食，比曉，霸先帥麾下出莫府山。

translations.literal: On yimao, before dawn they ate in their bedding; by daybreak Baxian led his personal following out from Mofu Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, before dawn they ate in their bedding; by daybreak Chen Baxian led his personal following out from Mofu Mountain.

sentences.zh: 侯安都謂其部將蕭摩訶曰：「卿驍勇有名，千聞不如一見。

translations.literal: Hou Andu said to his subordinate general Xiao Mohe, "You have a famous name for valor—a thousand hears are not equal to one seeing.
translations.idiomatic: Hou Andu said to his subordinate general Xiao Mohe, "You have a famous name for valor—a thousand hears are not equal to one seeing.

sentences.zh: 」摩訶對曰：「今日令公見之。

translations.literal: " Mohe replied, "Today let the lord see it.
translations.idiomatic: " Mohe replied, "Today let the lord see it.

sentences.zh: 」及戰，安都墜馬，齊人圍之，摩訶單騎大呼，直衝齊軍，齊軍披靡，安都乃免。

translations.literal: " When they fought, Andu fell from his horse and Qi men surrounded him; Mohe alone on horseback shouted greatly, charged straight into the Qi army; Qi armies broke and scattered; Andu was then saved.
translations.idiomatic: " When they fought, Andu fell from his horse and Qi men surrounded him; Mohe alone on horseback shouted greatly, charged straight into the Qi army; Qi armies broke and scattered; Andu was then saved.

sentences.zh: 霸先與吳明徹、沈泰等眾軍首尾齊舉，縱兵大戰，安都自白下引兵橫出其後，齊師大潰，斬獲數千人，相蹂籍而死者不可勝計。

translations.literal: Baxian with Wu Mingche, Shen Tai, and the mass of armies struck head and tail together, loosed troops in great battle; Andu from Baixia led troops to strike out from their rear; Qi armies were greatly routed; several thousand were beheaded or captured; those trampled and crushed to death were beyond counting.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Baxian with Wu Mingche, Shen Tai, and the mass of armies struck head and tail together, loosed troops in great battle; Andu from Baixia led troops to strike out from their rear; Qi armies were greatly routed; several thousand were beheaded or captured; those trampled and crushed to death were beyond counting.

sentences.zh: 生擒徐嗣徽及其弟嗣宗，斬之以徇，追奔至於臨沂。

translations.literal: They took alive Xu Sihui and his younger brother Sizong, beheaded them to display, and pursued the rout to Linyi.
translations.idiomatic: They took alive Xu Sihui and his younger brother Sizong, beheaded them to display, and pursued the rout to Linyi.

sentences.zh: 其江乘、攝山、鐘山等諸軍相次克捷，虜蕭軌、東方老、王敬寶等將帥凡四十六人。

translations.literal: The armies at Jiangcheng, Sheshan, Zhongshan, and elsewhere in succession won victories; they captured generals Xiao Gui, Dongfang Lao, Wang Jingbao, and others—forty-six commanders in all.
translations.idiomatic: The armies at Jiangcheng, Sheshan, Zhongshan, and elsewhere in succession won victories; they captured generals Xiao Gui, Dongfang Lao, Wang Jingbao, and others—forty-six commanders in all.

sentences.zh: 其軍士得竄至江者，縛荻筏以濟，中江而溺，流屍至京口，翳水彌岸；

translations.literal: Qi soldiers who fled to the river bound reed rafts to cross; mid-river they drowned; floating corpses reached Jingkou and darkened the water across the shore;
translations.idiomatic: Qi soldiers who fled to the river bound reed rafts to cross; mid-river they drowned; floating corpses reached Jingkou and darkened the water across the shore;

sentences.zh: 唯任約、王僧愔得免。

translations.literal: only Ren Yue and Wang Sengyin escaped.
translations.idiomatic: only Ren Yue and Wang Sengyin escaped.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，眾軍出南州，燒齊舟艦。

translations.literal: On dingsi, the mass of armies went out to Nanzhou and burned Qi ships.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, the mass of armies went out to Nanzhou and burned Qi ships.

sentences.zh: 戊午，大赦。

translations.literal: On wuwu, a general amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, a general amnesty.

sentences.zh: 己未，解嚴。

translations.literal: On jiwei, the strict alert was lifted.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, the strict alert was lifted.

sentences.zh: 軍士以賞俘貿酒，一人裁得一醉。

translations.literal: Soldiers traded captive rewards for wine; one man could barely get one drunk.
translations.idiomatic: Soldiers traded captive rewards for wine; one man could barely get one drunk.

sentences.zh: 庚申，斬齊將蕭軌等，齊人聞之，亦殺陳曇朗。

translations.literal: On gengshen, Qi generals Xiao Gui and others were beheaded; when Qi men heard of it, they also killed Chen Tanlang.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, Qi generals Xiao Gui and others were beheaded; when Qi men heard of it, they also killed Chen Tanlang.

sentences.zh: 霸先啟解南徐州以授侯安都。

translations.literal: Baxian memorialized to relinquish southern Xuzhou and grant it to Hou Andu.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Baxian memorialized to relinquish southern Xuzhou and grant it to Hou Andu.

sentences.zh: 侯平頻破後梁軍，以王琳兵威不接，更不受指麾；

translations.literal: Hou Ping repeatedly defeated Later Liang armies; because Wang Lin's military prestige did not reach him, he no longer accepted orders;
translations.idiomatic: Hou Ping repeatedly defeated Later Liang armies; because Wang Lin's military prestige did not reach him, he no longer accepted orders;

sentences.zh: 琳遣將討之。

translations.literal: Lin sent a general to campaign against him.
translations.idiomatic: Lin sent a general to campaign against him.

sentences.zh: 平殺巴州助防呂旬，收其眾，奔江州，侯瑱與之結為兄弟。

translations.literal: Ping killed Bazhou aid-defense commander Lü Xun, gathered his following, fled to Jiangzhou, and Hou Tian bonded with him as sworn brothers.
translations.idiomatic: Ping killed Bazhou aid-defense commander Lü Xun, gathered his following, fled to Jiangzhou, and Hou Tian bonded with him as sworn brothers.

sentences.zh: 琳軍勢益衰，乙丑，遣使奉表詣齊，並獻馴象。

translations.literal: Lin's military power daily weakened; on yichou he sent envoys with a memorial to Qi and also presented tame elephants.
translations.idiomatic: Lin's military power daily weakened; on yichou he sent envoys with a memorial to Qi and also presented tame elephants.

sentences.zh: 江陵之陷也，琳妻蔡氏、世子毅皆沒於魏，琳又獻款於魏以求妻子；

translations.literal: When Jiangling fell, Lin's wife Lady Cai and heir apparent Yi were both lost to Wei; Lin again offered submission to Wei to recover wife and children;
translations.idiomatic: When Jiangling fell, Lin's wife Lady Cai and heir apparent Yi were both lost to Wei; Lin again offered submission to Wei to recover wife and children;

sentences.zh: 亦稱臣於梁。

translations.literal: he also declared himself subject to Liang.
translations.idiomatic: he also declared himself subject to Liang.

sentences.zh: 齊發丁匠三十餘萬，修廣三台宮殿。

translations.literal: Qi mobilized more than three hundred thousand corvée laborers to repair and enlarge the Santai palaces.
translations.idiomatic: Qi mobilized more than three hundred thousand corvée laborers to repair and enlarge the Santai palaces.

sentences.zh: 齊顯祖之初立也，留心政術，務存簡靖，坦於任使，人得盡力。

translations.literal: When Qi Emperor Xianzu was first enthroned, he attended to statecraft, sought simplicity and calm, was open in appointment and employment, and men could give their full effort.
translations.idiomatic: When Qi Emperor Xianzu was first enthroned, he attended to statecraft, sought simplicity and calm, was open in appointment and employment, and men could give their full effort.

sentences.zh: 又能以法馭下，或有違犯，不容勳戚，內外莫不肅然。

translations.literal: He could also govern subordinates by law; if anyone violated it, he spared neither merit nor kin; inside and outside none were not awed.
translations.idiomatic: He could also govern subordinates by law; if anyone violated it, he spared neither merit nor kin; inside and outside none were not awed.

sentences.zh: 至於軍國機策，獨決懷抱；

translations.literal: As for military and state stratagems, he alone decided in his breast;
translations.idiomatic: As for military and state stratagems, he alone decided in his breast;

sentences.zh: 每臨行陣，親當矢石，所向有功。

translations.literal: whenever he faced battle lines he personally met arrows and stones, and where he went there was achievement.
translations.idiomatic: whenever he faced battle lines he personally met arrows and stones, and where he went there was achievement.

sentences.zh: 數年之後，漸以功業自矜，遂嗜酒淫泆，肆行狂暴；

translations.literal: After several years he gradually took pride in his achievements, then loved wine and dissipation, and indulged wild violence;
translations.idiomatic: After several years he gradually took pride in his achievements, then loved wine and dissipation, and indulged wild violence;

sentences.zh: 或身自歌舞，盡日通宵；

translations.literal: sometimes he sang and danced himself, all day through the night;
translations.idiomatic: sometimes he sang and danced himself, all day through the night;

sentences.zh: 或散發胡服，雜衣錦彩；

translations.literal: sometimes he loosed his hair in barbarian dress, mixed with brocade and color;
translations.idiomatic: sometimes he loosed his hair in barbarian dress, mixed with brocade and color;

sentences.zh: 或袒露形體，塗傅粉黛；

translations.literal: sometimes he bared his body and smeared powder and rouge;
translations.idiomatic: sometimes he bared his body and smeared powder and rouge;

sentences.zh: 或乘牛、驢、橐駝、白象，不施鞍勒；

translations.literal: sometimes he rode ox, donkey, camel, or white elephant without saddle or bridle;
translations.idiomatic: sometimes he rode ox, donkey, camel, or white elephant without saddle or bridle;

sentences.zh: 或令崔季舒、劉桃枝負之而行，擔胡鼓拍之；

translations.literal: sometimes he had Cui Jishu and Liu Taozhi carry him walking, shouldering barbarian drums and beating them;
translations.idiomatic: sometimes he had Cui Jishu and Liu Taozhi carry him walking, shouldering barbarian drums and beating them;

sentences.zh: 勳戚之第，朝夕臨幸，遊行市裡，街坐巷宿；

translations.literal: the mansions of merit and kin he visited morning and evening, roamed the markets, sat in streets and slept in lanes;
translations.idiomatic: the mansions of merit and kin he visited morning and evening, roamed the markets, sat in streets and slept in lanes;

sentences.zh: 或盛夏日中暴身，或隆冬去衣馳走；

translations.literal: sometimes in high summer he exposed his body at noon, sometimes in deep winter he stripped and ran;
translations.idiomatic: sometimes in high summer he exposed his body at noon, sometimes in deep winter he stripped and ran;

sentences.zh: 從者不堪，帝居之自若。

translations.literal: followers could not bear it; the emperor dwelt in it as if natural.
translations.idiomatic: followers could not bear it; the emperor dwelt in it as if natural.

sentences.zh: 三台構木高二十七丈，兩棟相距二百餘尺，工匠危怯，皆繫繩自防，帝登脊疾走，殊無怖畏；

translations.literal: Santai timber structures rose twenty-seven zhang; the two ridgepoles were more than two hundred chi apart; craftsmen in peril tied ropes to protect themselves; the emperor ran swiftly along the ridge without fear;
translations.idiomatic: Santai timber structures rose twenty-seven zhang; the two ridgepoles were more than two hundred chi apart; craftsmen in peril tied ropes to protect themselves; the emperor ran swiftly along the ridge without fear;

sentences.zh: 時復雅舞，折旋中節，傍人見者莫不寒心。

translations.literal: sometimes he also performed refined dance, turning within the measure; those who saw it nearby were all chilled at heart.
translations.idiomatic: sometimes he also performed refined dance, turning within the measure; those who saw it nearby were all chilled at heart.

sentences.zh: 嘗於道上問婦人曰：「天子何如？

translations.literal: Once on the road he asked a woman, "What is the Son of Heaven like?
translations.idiomatic: Once on the road he asked a woman, "What is the Son of Heaven like?

sentences.zh: 」曰：「顛顛癡癡，何成天子！

translations.literal: " She said, "Tottering, addled—how could he become Son of Heaven!
translations.idiomatic: " She said, "Tottering, addled—how could he become Son of Heaven!

sentences.zh: 」帝殺之。

translations.literal: " The emperor killed her.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor killed her.

sentences.zh: 婁太后以帝酒狂，舉杖擊之曰：「如此父生如此兒！

translations.literal: Empress Dowager Lou, because the emperor was drunk and wild, raised her staff and struck him, saying, "Such a father bore such a son!
translations.idiomatic: Empress Dowager Lou, because the emperor was drunk and wild, raised her staff and struck him, saying, "Such a father bore such a son!

translations.idiomatic: Of those killed, many he ordered dismembered, or burned in fire, or cast into water.

translations.idiomatic: If three months passed without killing, he pardoned them.

translations.literal: Tian's host collapsed; he fled to Pencheng and relied on his general Jiao Sengdu.
translations.idiomatic: Tian's host collapsed; he fled to Pencheng and relied on his general Jiao Sengdu.

sentences.zh: 僧度勸之奔齊，會霸先使記室濟陽蔡景歷南上，說瑱令降，瑱乃詣闕歸罪，霸先為之誅侯平。

translations.literal: Sengdu urged him to flee to Qi; just then Baxian sent recorder Jiyang Cai Jingli south, persuaded Tian to surrender; Tian then went to court to confess guilt; Baxian executed Hou Ping for him.
translations.idiomatic: Sengdu urged him to flee to Qi; just then Chen Baxian sent recorder Jiyang Cai Jingli south, persuaded Tian to surrender; Tian then went to court to confess guilt; Chen Baxian executed Hou Ping for him.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，以瑱為司空。

translations.literal: On dinghai, Tian was made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, Tian was made minister of works.

sentences.zh: 南昌民熊曇朗，世為郡著姓。

translations.literal: Nanchang native Xiong Tanlang, for generations a noted clan of the commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Nanchang native Xiong Tanlang, for generations a noted clan of the commandery.

sentences.zh: 曇朗有勇力，侯景之亂，聚眾據豐城為柵，世祖以為巴山太守。

translations.literal: Tanlang had courage and strength; in Hou Jing's rebellion he gathered a host, held Fengcheng with a palisade; Shizu made him Bashan Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: Tanlang had courage and strength; in Hou Jing's rebellion he gathered a host, held Fengcheng with a palisade; Shizu made him Bashan inspector.

sentences.zh: 江陵陷，曇朗兵力浸強，侵掠鄰縣。

translations.literal: When Jiangling fell, Tanlang's military power gradually grew strong and he raided neighboring counties.
translations.idiomatic: When Jiangling fell, Tanlang's military power gradually grew strong and he raided neighboring counties.

sentences.zh: 侯瑱在豫章，曇朗外示服從而陰圖之，及瑱敗走，曇朗獲其馬仗。

translations.literal: Hou Tian was at Yuzhang; Tanlang outwardly showed submission but secretly plotted against him; when Tian was defeated and fled, Tanlang took his horses and weapons.
translations.idiomatic: Hou Tian was at Yuzhang; Tanlang outwardly showed submission but secretly plotted against him; when Tian was defeated and fled, Tanlang took his horses and weapons.

sentences.zh: 己亥，齊大赦。

translations.literal: On jihai, Qi proclaimed a general amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, Qi proclaimed a general amnesty.

sentences.zh: 魏太師泰遣安州長史鉗耳康買使於王琳，琳遣長史席豁報之，且請歸世祖及愍懷太子之柩；

translations.literal: Wei Grand Preceptor Tai sent Anzhou chief clerk Qian'er Kangmai as envoy to Wang Lin; Lin sent chief clerk Xi Huo in reply and also asked to return the coffins of Shizu and the Minhuai heir apparent;
translations.idiomatic: Western Wei grand preceptor Yuwen Tai sent Anzhou chief clerk Qian'er Kangmai as envoy to Wang Lin; Lin sent chief clerk Xi Huo in reply and also asked to return the coffins of Shizu and the Minhuai heir apparent;

sentences.zh: 泰許之。

translations.literal: Tai permitted it.
translations.idiomatic: Yuwen Tai permitted it.

sentences.zh: 八月，己酉，鄱陽王循卒於江夏，弟豐城侯泰監郢州事。

translations.literal: Eighth month, on jiyou, Prince Xun of Poyang died at Jiangxia; his younger brother Marquis Tai of Fengcheng supervised Yingzhou affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, on jiyou, Prince Xun of Poyang died at Jiangxia; his younger brother Marquis Tai of Fengcheng supervised Yingzhou affairs.

sentences.zh: 王琳使兗州刺史吳藏攻江夏，不克而死。

translations.literal: Wang Lin sent Yanzhou Inspector Wu Zang to attack Jiangxia; he did not overcome it and died.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Lin sent Yanzhou inspector Wu Zang to attack Jiangxia; he did not overcome it and died.

sentences.zh: 魏太師泰北渡河。

translations.literal: Wei Grand Preceptor Tai crossed the river north.
translations.idiomatic: Western Wei grand preceptor Yuwen Tai crossed the river north.

sentences.zh: 魏以王琳為大將軍、長沙郡公。

translations.literal: Wei made Wang Lin Grand General and Duke of Changsha commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Western Wei made Wang Lin grand general and duke of Changsha commandery.

sentences.zh: 魏江州刺史陸騰討陵州叛獠，獠因山為城，攻之難拔。

translations.literal: Wei Jiangzhou Inspector Lu Teng campaigned against rebellious Liao of Lingzhou; the Liao used mountains as walls and were hard to storm.
translations.idiomatic: Western Wei Jiangzhou inspector Lu Teng campaigned against rebellious Liao of Lingzhou; the Liao used mountains as walls and were hard to storm.

sentences.zh: 騰乃陳伎樂於城下一面，獠棄兵，攜妻子臨城觀之，騰潛師三面俱上，斬首萬五千級，遂平之。

translations.literal: Teng then arrayed performers and music on one face below the wall; the Liao abandoned weapons, brought wives and children to the wall to watch; Teng secretly sent troops up on three faces together, beheaded fifteen thousand heads, and pacified them.
translations.idiomatic: Teng then arrayed performers and music on one face below the wall; the Liao abandoned weapons, brought wives and children to the wall to watch; Teng secretly sent troops up on three faces together, beheaded fifteen thousand heads, and pacified them.

sentences.zh: 騰，俟之玄孫也。

translations.literal: Teng was Hou's great-great-grandson.
translations.idiomatic: Teng was Lu Hou's great-great-grandson.

sentences.zh: 庚申，齊主將西巡，百官辭於紫陌，帝使槊騎圍之，曰：「我舉鞭，即殺之。

translations.literal: On gengshen, the Qi ruler was about to tour west; the hundred officials took leave at Zimo; the emperor sent spear-horsemen to surround them and said, "When I raise the whip, kill them at once.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, the Qi ruler was about to tour west; the hundred officials took leave at Zimo; the emperor sent spear-horsemen to surround them and said, "When I raise the whip, kill them at once.

sentences.zh: 」日晏，帝醉不能起。

translations.literal: " The day grew late; the emperor was drunk and could not rise.
translations.idiomatic: " The day grew late; the emperor was drunk and could not rise.

sentences.zh: 黃門郎是連子暢曰：「陛下如此，群臣不勝恐怖。

translations.literal: Yellow Gate Gentleman Shilian Zichang said, "Your Majesty is thus—the ministers cannot bear the terror.
translations.idiomatic: Yellow gate gentleman Shilian Zichang said, "Your Majesty is thus—the ministers cannot bear the terror.

sentences.zh: 」帝曰：「大怖邪？

translations.literal: " The emperor said, "Greatly terrified?
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor said, "Greatly terrified?

sentences.zh: 若然，勿殺。

translations.literal: If so, do not kill.
translations.idiomatic: If so, do not kill.

sentences.zh: 」遂如晉陽。

translations.literal: " He then went on to Jinyang.
translations.idiomatic: " He then went on to Jinyang.

sentences.zh: 九月，壬寅，改元，大赦。

translations.literal: Ninth month, on renyin, the era name was changed and a general amnesty proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, on renyin, the era name was changed and a general amnesty proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 以陳霸先為丞相、錄尚書事、鎮衛大將軍、揚州牧、義興公。

translations.literal: Chen Baxian was made Chancellor, Recorder of Affairs of the Secretariat, Guarding-the-Realm Grand General, Yangzhou Governor, Duke of Yixing.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Baxian was made chancellor, recorder of affairs of the secretariat, guarding-the-realm grand general, Yangzhou governor, Duke of Yixing.

sentences.zh: 以吏部尚書王通為右僕射。

translations.literal: Wang Tong, Minister of Personnel, was made Right Vice Director.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Tong, minister of personnel, was made right vice director.

sentences.zh: 突厥木桿可汗假道於涼州以襲吐谷渾，魏太師泰使涼州刺史史寧帥騎隨之，至番禾，吐谷渾覺之，奔南山。

translations.literal: Tujue Khan Mugan asked passage through Liangzhou to strike Tuyuhun; Wei Grand Preceptor Tai sent Liangzhou Inspector Shi Ning to lead horsemen with him; reaching Fanhe, Tuyuhun detected them and fled to the southern mountains.
translations.idiomatic: Tujue khan Mugan asked passage through Liangzhou to strike Tuyuhun; Western Wei grand preceptor Yuwen Tai sent Liangzhou inspector Shi Ning to lead horsemen with him; reaching Fanhe, Tuyuhun detected them and fled to the southern mountains.

sentences.zh: 木桿將分兵追之，寧曰：「樹敦、賀真二城，吐谷渾之巢穴也。

translations.literal: Mugan was about to divide troops to pursue; Ning said, "The two cities Shudun and Hezhen are Tuyuhun's lairs.
translations.idiomatic: Mugan was about to divide troops to pursue; Ning said, "The two cities Shudun and Hezhen are Tuyuhun's lairs.

sentences.zh: 拔其本根，餘眾自散。

translations.literal: Pull up the roots and the remaining host will scatter of itself.
translations.idiomatic: Pull up the roots and the remaining host will scatter of itself.

sentences.zh: 」木桿從之。

translations.literal: " Mugan followed this.
translations.idiomatic: " Mugan followed this.

sentences.zh: 木桿從北道趣賀真，寧從南道趣樹敦。

translations.literal: Mugan from the northern route aimed at Hezhen; Ning from the southern route aimed at Shudun.
translations.idiomatic: Mugan from the northern route aimed at Hezhen; Ning from the southern route aimed at Shudun.

sentences.zh: 吐谷渾可汗誇呂在賀真，使其征南王將數千人守樹敦。

translations.literal: Tuyuhun Khan Kualü was at Hezhen and sent his southern-campaigning king with several thousand to hold Shudun.
translations.idiomatic: Tuyuhun khan Kualü was at Hezhen and sent his southern-campaigning king with several thousand to hold Shudun.

sentences.zh: 木桿破賀真，獲誇呂妻子；

translations.literal: Mugan broke Hezhen and took Kualü's wife and children;
translations.idiomatic: Mugan broke Hezhen and took Kualü's wife and children;

sentences.zh: 寧破樹敦，虜征南王，還，與木桿會於青海，木桿歎寧勇決，贈遺甚厚。

translations.literal: Ning broke Shudun and captured the southern-campaigning king; returning, he met Mugan at Qinghai; Mugan sighed at Ning's courage and decisiveness and gave gifts very generously.
translations.idiomatic: Ning broke Shudun and captured the southern-campaigning king; returning, he met Mugan at Qinghai; Mugan sighed at Ning's courage and decisiveness and gave gifts very generously.

sentences.zh: 甲子，王琳以舟師襲江夏；

translations.literal: On jiazi, Wang Lin with the fleet raided Jiangxia;
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, Wang Lin with the fleet raided Jiangxia;

sentences.zh: 冬，十月，壬申，豐城侯泰以州降之。

translations.literal: winter, tenth month, on renshen, Marquis Tai of Fengcheng surrendered the province to him.
translations.idiomatic: winter, tenth month, on renshen, Marquis Tai of Fengcheng surrendered the province to him.

sentences.zh: 齊發山東寡婦二千六百人以配軍，有夫而濫奪者什二三。

translations.literal: Qi mobilized twenty-six hundred widows of Shandong to assign to the army; of those with husbands, one or two in ten were wrongly taken.
translations.idiomatic: Qi mobilized twenty-six hundred widows of Shandong to assign to the army; of those with husbands, one or two in ten were wrongly taken.

sentences.zh: 魏安定文公宇文泰還至牽屯山而病，驛召中山公護。

translations.literal: Wei Duke Wen of Anding Yuwen Tai, returning, fell ill at Qiantun Mountain; by post horse he summoned Duke Hu of Zhongshan.
translations.idiomatic: Western Wei Duke Wen of Anding Yuwen Tai, returning, fell ill at Qiantun Mountain; by post horse he summoned Duke Hu of Zhongshan.

sentences.zh: 護至涇州，見泰，泰謂護曰：「吾諸子皆幼，外寇方強，天下之事，屬之於汝，宜努力以成吾志。

translations.literal: Hu reached Jingzhou, saw Tai; Tai told Hu, "My sons are all young; outer enemies are just strong; the affairs of the realm are entrusted to you—you should strive to fulfill my aim.
translations.idiomatic: Hu reached Jingzhou, saw Tai; Tai told Hu, "My sons are all young; outer enemies are just strong; the affairs of the realm are entrusted to you—you should strive to fulfill my aim.

sentences.zh: 」乙亥，卒於雲陽。

translations.literal: " On yihai he died at Yunyang.
translations.idiomatic: " On yihai he died at Yunyang.

sentences.zh: 護還長安，發喪。

translations.literal: Hu returned to Chang'an and proclaimed mourning.
translations.idiomatic: Hu returned to Chang'an and proclaimed mourning.

sentences.zh: 泰能駕御英豪，得其力用，性好質素，不尚虛飾，明達政事，崇儒好古，凡所施設，皆依仿三代而為之。

translations.literal: Tai could drive and control heroes, gain their strength for use; his nature loved simplicity, did not esteem empty display; he was clear in government affairs, honored Confucians and loved antiquity; all he established imitated the Three Dynasties.
translations.idiomatic: Tai could drive and control heroes, gain their strength for use; his nature loved simplicity, did not esteem empty display; he was clear in government affairs, honored Confucians and loved antiquity; all he established imitated the Three Dynasties.

sentences.zh: 丙子，世子覺嗣位，為太師、柱國、大塚宰，出鎮同州，時年十五。

translations.literal: On bingzi the heir apparent Jue succeeded, was Grand Preceptor, pillar of state, Grand Chief Minister, went out to garrison Tongzhou—at the time fifteen years old.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi the heir apparent Jue succeeded, was grand preceptor, pillar of state, grand chief minister, went out to garrison Tongzhou—at the time fifteen years old.

sentences.zh: 中山公護，名位素卑，雖為泰所屬，而群公各圖執政，莫肯服從。

translations.literal: Duke Hu of Zhongshan, his name and rank had always been low; though Tai had entrusted him, the various lords each plotted to hold government and none would obey.
translations.idiomatic: Duke Hu of Zhongshan, his name and rank had always been low; though Tai had entrusted him, the various lords each plotted to hold government and none would obey.

sentences.zh: 護問計於大司寇於謹，謹曰：「謹早蒙先公非常之知，恩深骨肉，今日之事，必以死爭之。

translations.literal: Hu asked counsel of Grand Judge Yu Jin; Jin said, "Jin early received the late lord's extraordinary trust, grace deep as bone and flesh; today's matter I must contend for with death.
translations.idiomatic: Hu asked counsel of grand judge Yu Jin; Jin said, "Jin early received the late lord's extraordinary trust, grace deep as bone and flesh; today's matter I must contend for with death.

sentences.zh: 若對眾定策，公必不得讓。

translations.literal: If we settle policy before the assembly, you surely cannot yield.
translations.idiomatic: If we settle policy before the assembly, you surely cannot yield.

sentences.zh: 」明日，群公會議，謹曰：「昔帝室傾危，非安定公無復今日。

translations.literal: " Next day the lords met in council; Jin said, "Formerly the imperial house was toppling; without Duke Wen of Anding there would be no today.
translations.idiomatic: " Next day the lords met in council; Jin said, "Formerly the imperial house was toppling; without Duke Wen of Anding there would be no today.

sentences.zh: 今公一旦違世，嗣子雖幼，中山公親其兄子，兼受顧托，軍國之事，理須歸之。

translations.literal: Now the duke has suddenly left the world; the heir though young, Duke Hu of Zhongshan is his elder brother's son and also received entrustment—military and state affairs by right must return to him.
translations.idiomatic: Now the duke has suddenly left the world; the heir though young, Duke Hu of Zhongshan is his elder brother's son and also received entrustment—military and state affairs by right must return to him.

sentences.zh: 」辭色抗厲，眾皆悚動。

translations.literal: " His words and bearing were stern and fierce; the assembly all trembled.
translations.idiomatic: " His words and bearing were stern and fierce; the assembly all trembled.

sentences.zh: 護曰：「此乃家事，護雖庸昧，何敢有辭！

translations.literal: Hu said, "This is a family matter; though Hu is dull and obscure, how dare I decline!
translations.idiomatic: Hu said, "This is a family matter; though Hu is dull and obscure, how dare I decline!

sentences.zh: 」謹素與泰等夷，護常拜之，至是，謹起而言曰：「公若統理軍國，謹等皆有所依。

translations.literal: " Jin had always been Tai's equal; Hu often bowed to him; at this Jin rose and said, "If you govern military and state affairs, Jin and the rest all have someone to rely on.
translations.idiomatic: " Jin had always been Tai's equal; Hu often bowed to him; at this Jin rose and said, "If you govern military and state affairs, Jin and the rest all have someone to rely on.

sentences.zh: 」遂再拜。

translations.literal: " He then bowed twice.
translations.idiomatic: " He then bowed twice.

sentences.zh: 群公迫於謹，亦再拜，於是眾議始定。

translations.literal: The lords, pressed by Jin, also bowed twice; thereupon the assembly's deliberation was settled.
translations.idiomatic: The lords, pressed by Jin, also bowed twice; thereupon the assembly's deliberation was settled.

sentences.zh: 護綱紀內外，撫循文武，人心遂安。

translations.literal: Hu ordered inside and outside, comforted civil and military; men's hearts were then at peace.
translations.idiomatic: Hu ordered inside and outside, comforted civil and military; men's hearts were then at peace.

sentences.zh: 十一月，辛丑，豐城侯泰奔齊，齊以為永州刺史。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, on xinchou, Marquis Tai of Fengcheng fled to Qi; Qi made him Yongzhou Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, on xinchou, Marquis Tai of Fengcheng fled to Qi; Qi made him Yongzhou inspector.

sentences.zh: 詔征王琳為司空，琳辭不至，留其將潘純陀監郢州，身還長沙。

translations.literal: An edict summoned Wang Lin as Minister of Works; Lin declined and did not come; he left his general Pan Chuntuo to oversee Yingzhou and himself returned to Changsha.
translations.idiomatic: An edict summoned Wang Lin as minister of works; Lin declined and did not come; he left his general Pan Chuntuo to oversee Yingzhou and himself returned to Changsha.

sentences.zh: 魏人歸其妻子。

translations.literal: Wei men returned his wife and children.
translations.idiomatic: Western Wei men returned his wife and children.

sentences.zh: 壬子，齊主詔以「魏末豪傑糾合鄉部，因緣請托，各立州郡，離大合小，公私煩費，丁口減於疇日，守令倍於昔時，且要荒向化，舊多浮偽，百室之邑，遽立州名，三戶之民，空張郡目，循名督實，事歸焉有。

translations.literal: On renzi the Qi ruler edicted that "at the end of Wei, bold men gathered township divisions, used connections and petitions, each established provinces and commanderies, split large and joined small—public and private were vexed with expense; household mouths were fewer than in former days, magistrates and prefects twice as many as before; moreover frontier wastes turned to civilization, old abuses were mostly empty fraud—a town of a hundred houses hastily took a province's name; people of three households vainly spread a commandery's title; pursuing names and examining realities, the matter came to nothing.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi the Qi ruler edicted that "at the end of Wei, bold men gathered township divisions, used connections and petitions, each established provinces and commanderies, split large and joined small—public and private were vexed with expense; household mouths were fewer than in former days, magistrates and prefects twice as many as before; moreover frontier wastes turned to civilization, old abuses were mostly empty fraud—a town of a hundred houses hastily took a province's name; people of three households vainly spread a commandery's title; pursuing names and examining realities, the matter came to nothing.

sentences.zh: 」於是並省三州、一百五十三郡、五百八十九縣、三鎮、二十六戍。

translations.literal: " Thereupon they merged and cut three provinces, one hundred fifty-three commanderies, five hundred eighty-nine counties, three garrisons, and twenty-six forts.
translations.idiomatic: " Thereupon they merged and cut three provinces, one hundred fifty-three commanderies, five hundred eighty-nine counties, three garrisons, and twenty-six forts.

sentences.zh: 詔分江州四郡置高州。

translations.literal: An edict divided four commanderies of Jiangzhou to establish Gaozhou.
translations.idiomatic: An edict divided four commanderies of Jiangzhou to establish Gaozhou.

sentences.zh: 以明威將軍黃法□為刺史，鎮巴山。

translations.literal: Mingwei General Huang Fa□ was made inspector and garrisoned Bashan.
translations.idiomatic: Mingwei general Huang Fa□ was made inspector and garrisoned Bashan.

sentences.zh: 十二月，壬申，以曲江侯勃為太保。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, on renshen, Marquis Bo of Qujiang was made Grand Guardian.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, on renshen, Marquis Bo of Qujiang was made grand guardian.

sentences.zh: 甲申，魏葬安定文公。

translations.literal: On jiashen, Wei buried Duke Wen of Anding.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, Western Wei buried Duke Wen of Anding.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，以岐陽之地封世子覺為周公。

translations.literal: On dinghai, the land of Qiyang was enfeoffed to heir apparent Jue as Duke of Zhou.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, the land of Qiyang was enfeoffed to heir apparent Jue as Duke of Zhou.

sentences.zh: 初，侯景之亂，臨川民周續起兵郡中，始興王毅以郡讓之而去。

translations.literal: Earlier, in Hou Jing's rebellion, Linchuan native Zhou Xu raised troops in the commandery; Prince Yi of Shixing yielded the commandery to him and left.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, in Hou Jing's rebellion, Linchuan native Zhou Xu raised troops in the commandery; Prince Yi of Shixing yielded the commandery to him and left.

sentences.zh: 續部將皆郡中豪族，多驕橫，續裁製之，諸將皆怨，相與殺之。

translations.literal: Xu's subordinate generals were all great clans of the commandery, mostly proud and overbearing; Xu restrained them; the generals all resented him and together killed him.
translations.idiomatic: Xu's subordinate generals were all great clans of the commandery, mostly proud and overbearing; Xu restrained them; the generals all resented him and together killed him.

sentences.zh: 續宗人迪，勇冠軍中，眾推為主。

translations.literal: Xu's clansman Di, courage foremost in the army, the host pushed as leader.
translations.idiomatic: Xu's clansman Di, courage foremost in the army, the host pushed as leader.

sentences.zh: 迪素寒微，恐郡人不服，以同郡周敷族望高顯，折節交之，敷亦事迪甚謹。

translations.literal: Di had always been poor and low; he feared the commandery would not submit; he treated with deference Zhou Fu of the same commandery, whose clan prestige was high and bright; Fu also served Di very respectfully.
translations.idiomatic: Di had always been poor and low; he feared the commandery would not submit; he treated with deference Zhou Fu of the same commandery, whose clan prestige was high and bright; Fu also served Di very respectfully.

sentences.zh: 迪據上塘，敷據故郡，朝廷以迪為衡州刺史，領臨川內史。

translations.literal: Di held Shangtang; Fu held the old commandery seat; the court made Di Hengzhou Inspector and acting Linchuan Administrator.
translations.idiomatic: Di held Shangtang; Fu held the old commandery seat; the court made Di Hengzhou inspector and acting Linchuan administrator.

sentences.zh: 時民遭侯景之亂，皆棄農業，群聚為盜，唯迪所部獨務農桑，各有贏儲，政教嚴明，征斂必至，餘郡乏絕者皆仰以取給。

translations.literal: At that time the people, having suffered Hou Jing's rebellion, all abandoned farming and gathered as bandits; only in Di's territory did they alone devote themselves to agriculture and sericulture, each household having surplus stores; government and teaching were strict and clear, levies always arrived; commanderies that lacked all relied on him for supply.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the people, having suffered Hou Jing's rebellion, all abandoned farming and gathered as bandits; only in Di's territory did they alone devote themselves to agriculture and sericulture, each household having surplus stores; government and teaching were strict and clear, levies always arrived; commanderies that lacked all relied on him for supply.

sentences.zh: 迪性質樸，不事威儀，居常徒跣，雖外列兵衛，內有女伎，挼繩破篾，傍若無人，訥於言語而襟懷信實，臨川人皆附之。

translations.literal: Di's nature was plain and simple; he did not attend to imposing ceremony; he usually went barefoot; though outwardly he arrayed guards, inwardly he had female performers—twisting rope and splitting bamboo as if no one were beside him; slow in speech but his breast faithful and true; Linchuan people all attached to him.

sentences.zh: 齊自西河總秦戍築長城，東至於海，前後所築三千餘里，率十里一戍，其要害置州鎮，凡二十五所。

translations.literal: Qi from Zongqin garrison at Xihe built the Long Wall east to the sea; in all more than three thousand li built before and after; generally one fort every ten li; at vital points they set provinces and garrisons—twenty-five in all.

sentences.zh: 魏宇文護以周公幼弱，欲早使正位以定人心。

translations.literal: Wei Yuwen Hu, because the Duke of Zhou was young and weak, wished early to establish him in the true position to settle men's hearts.
translations.idiomatic: Western Wei's Yuwen Hu, because the Duke of Zhou was young and weak, wished early to establish him in the true position to settle men's hearts.

sentences.zh: 庚子，以魏恭帝詔禪位於周，使大宗伯趙貴持節奉冊，濟北公迪致皇帝璽紱；

translations.literal: On gengzi, by Wei Emperor Gong's edict the throne was yielded to Zhou; Grand Director of the Masses Zhao Gui bore the staff and presented the register; Duke Di of Jibei presented the imperial seal and cord;

sentences.zh: 恭帝出居大司馬府。
